```typescript
/**
 * Ecommerce Contract Utilities
 * 
 * Funciones para interactuar con el contrato Ecommerce
 */

import { ethers } from "ethers";

export interface Company {
  companyId: bigint;
  name: string;
  companyAddress: string;
  taxId: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  ownerAddress: string;
}

export interface Product {
  productId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: bigint;
  stock: bigint;
  ipfsImageHash: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Customer {
  customerAddress: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  registeredAt: bigint;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  customerAddress: string;
  totalAmount: bigint;
  timestamp: bigint;
  isPaid: boolean;
  paymentTxHash: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: bigint;
    quantity: bigint;
  }>;
}

export interface OperationResult {
  success: boolean;
  txHash?: string;
  error?: string;
}

// Ecommerce ABI mínimo (simplificado)
const ECOMMERCE_ABI = [
  "function registerCompany(string memory name, address companyAddress, string memory taxId) external returns (uint256)",
  "function updateCompany(uint256 companyId, string memory name, string memory taxId) external",
  "function setCompanyActive(uint256 companyId, bool isActive) external",
  "function getCompany(uint256 companyId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress))",
  "function getAllCompanies() external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress)[])",
  "function addProduct(uint256 companyId, string memory name, string memory description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string memory ipfsImageHash) external returns (uint256)",
  "function updateProduct(uint256 productId, uint256 price, uint256 stock) external",
  "function setProductActive(uint256 productId, bool isActive) external",
  "function getProduct(uint256 productId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive))",
  "function getAllProducts() external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive)[])",
  "function productsByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
  "function getInvoice(uint256 invoiceId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items))",
  "function getAllInvoices() external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items)[])",
  "function invoicesByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
] as const;

/**
 * Get Ecommerce contract instance
 */
export function getEcommerceContract(signerOrProvider: ethers.Provider | ethers.Signer) {
  const address = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
  if (!address) {
    throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS not configured");
  }
  return new ethers.Contract(address, ECOMMERCE_ABI, signerOrProvider);
}

/**
 * Register a company
 */
export async function registerCompany(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  name: string,
  companyAddress: string,
  taxId: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.registerCompany(name, companyAddress, taxId);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Company registration failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update company
 */
export async function updateCompany(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number,
  name: string,
  taxId: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.updateCompany(companyId, name, taxId);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Company update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Set company active/inactive
 */
export async function setCompanyActive(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number,
  isActive: boolean
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.setCompanyActive(companyId, isActive);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to update company status" };
  }
}

/**
 * Add a product
 */
export async function addProduct(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number,
  name: string,
  description: string,
  price: bigint,
  stock: number,
  ipfsImageHash: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.addProduct(companyId, name, description, price, stock, ipfsImageHash);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Product addition failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update a product
 */
export async function updateProduct(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number,
  price: bigint,
  stock: number
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.updateProduct(productId, price, stock);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Product update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Set product active/inactive
 */
export async function setProductActive(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number,
  isActive: boolean
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.setProductActive(productId, isActive);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to update product status" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get all companies
 */
export async function getAllCompanies(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Company[]> {
  const companies = await contract.getAllCompanies();
  return companies.map((c: any) => ({
    companyId: BigInt(c.companyId.toString()),
    name: c.name,
    companyAddress: c.companyAddress,
    taxId: c.taxId,
    isActive: c.isActive,
    ownerAddress: c.ownerAddress,
  }));
}

/**
 * Get company by ID
 */
export async function getCompany(contract: ethers.Contract, companyId: number): Promise<Company> {
  const company = await contract.getCompany(companyId);
  return {
    companyId: BigInt(company.companyId.toString()),
    name: company.name,
    companyAddress: company.companyAddress,
    taxId: company.taxId,
    isActive: company.isActive,
    ownerAddress: company.ownerAddress,
  };
}

/**
 * Get products by company
 */
export async function getProductsByCompany(contract: ethers.Contract, companyId: number): Promise<Product[]> {
  const productIds = await contract.productsByCompany(companyId);
  const products: Product[] = [];
  
  for (const productId of productIds) {
    const product = await contract.getProduct(Number(productId));
    products.push({
      productId: BigInt(product.productId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(product.companyId.toString()),
      name: product.name,
      description: product.description,
      price: BigInt(product.price.toString()),
      stock: BigInt(product.stock.toString()),
      ipfsImageHash: product.ipfsImageHash,
      isActive: product.isActive,
    });
  }
  
  return products;
}

/**
 * Get all products
 */
export async function getAllProducts(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Product[]> {
  const products = await contract.getAllProducts();
  return products.map((p: any) => ({
    productId: BigInt(p.productId.toString()),
    companyId: BigInt(p.companyId.toString()),
    name: p.name,
    description: p.description,
    price: BigInt(p.price.toString()),
    stock: BigInt(p.stock.toString()),
    ipfsImageHash: p.ipfsImageHash,
    isActive: p.isActive,
  }));
}

/**
 * Get product by ID
 */
export async function getProduct(contract: ethers.Contract, productId: number): Promise<Product> {
  const product = await contract.getProduct(productId);
  return {
    productId: BigInt(product.productId.toString()),
    companyId: BigInt(product.companyId.toString()),
    name: product.name,
    description: product.description,
    price: BigInt(product.price.toString()),
    stock: BigInt(product.stock.toString()),
    ipfsImageHash: product.ipfsImageHash,
    isActive: product.isActive,
  };
}

/**
 * Get invoices by company
 */
export async function getInvoicesByCompany(contract: ethers.Contract, companyId: number): Promise<Invoice[]> {
  const invoiceIds = await contract.invoicesByCompany(companyId);
  const invoices: Invoice[] = [];
  
  for (const invoiceId of invoiceIds) {
    const invoice = await contract.getInvoice(Number(invoiceId));
    invoices.push({
      invoiceId: BigInt(invoice.invoiceId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(invoice.companyId.toString()),
      customerAddress: invoice.customerAddress,
      totalAmount: BigInt(invoice.totalAmount.toString()),
      timestamp: BigInt(invoice.timestamp.toString()),
      isPaid: invoice.isPaid,
      paymentTxHash: invoice.paymentTxHash,
      items: invoice.items.map((item: any) => ({
        productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
        quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
      })),
    });
  }
  
  return invoices;
}

/**
 * Get all invoices
 */
export async function getAllInvoices(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Invoice[]> {
  const invoices = await contract.getAllInvoices();
  return invoices.map((inv: any) => ({
    invoiceId: BigInt(inv.invoiceId.toString()),
    companyId: BigInt(inv.companyId.toString()),
    customerAddress: inv.customerAddress,
    totalAmount: BigInt(inv.totalAmount.toString()),
    timestamp: BigInt(inv.timestamp.toString()),
    isPaid: inv.isPaid,
    paymentTxHash: inv.paymentTxHash,
    items: inv.items.map((item: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
      quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
    })),
  }));
}

/**
 * Get invoice by ID
 */
export async function getInvoice(contract: ethers.Contract, invoiceId: number): Promise<Invoice> {
  const invoice = await contract.getInvoice(invoiceId);
  return {
    invoiceId: BigInt(invoice.invoiceId.toString()),
    companyId: BigInt(invoice.companyId.toString()),
    customerAddress: invoice.customerAddress,
    totalAmount: BigInt(invoice.totalAmount.toString()),
    timestamp: BigInt(invoice.timestamp.toString()),
    isPaid: invoice.isPaid,
    paymentTxHash: invoice.paymentTxHash,
    items: invoice.items.map((item: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
      quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Reset Anvil blockchain
 */
export async function resetAnvil(): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/reset-anvil', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
    });
    
    if (!response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      return { success: false, error: data.error || 'Failed to reset Anvil' };
    }
    
    const data = await response.json();
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to reset Anvil' };
  }
}

/**
 * Get token balance for an address
 */
export async function getTokenBalance(
  tokenContract: ethers.Contract,
  address: string
): Promise<bigint> {
  const balance = await tokenContract.balanceOf(address);
  return BigInt(balance.toString());
}
```

```typescript
/**

 *

 */

import { POST } from '../reset-anvil/route';
import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

// Mock ethers
jest.mock('ethers', () => ({
  ethers: {
    JsonRpcProvider: jest.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({
      getBlockNumber: jest.fn(),
    })),
  },
}));

// Mock global fetch
global.fetch = jest.fn();

describe('/api/reset-anvil', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('should reset Anvil successfully', async () => {
    const { ethers } = require('ethers');
    const mockProvider = {
      getBlockNumber: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(1),
    };
    ethers.JsonRpcProvider.mockReturnValue(mockProvider);

    (global.fetch as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      json: async () => ({ success: true }),
    });

    const request = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/reset-anvil', {
      method: 'POST',
    });

    const response = await POST(request);
    const data = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(data.success).toBe(true);
    expect(global.fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'http://localhost:8545/reset',
      expect.objectContaining({ method: 'POST' })
    );
  });

  it('should return error if Anvil is not running', async () => {
    const { ethers } = require('ethers');
    const mockProvider = {
      getBlockNumber: jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Connection failed')),
    };
    ethers.JsonRpcProvider.mockReturnValue(mockProvider);

    const request = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/reset-anvil', {
      method: 'POST',
    });

    const response = await POST(request);
    const data = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
    expect(data.error).toContain('Anvil is not running');
    expect(global.fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('should handle Anvil reset error', async () => {
    const { ethers } = require('ethers');
    const mockProvider = {
      getBlockNumber: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(1),
    };
    ethers.JsonRpcProvider.mockReturnValue(mockProvider);

    (global.fetch as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue({
      ok: false,
      status: 500,
      json: async () => ({ error: 'Reset failed' }),
    });

    const request = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/reset-anvil', {
      method: 'POST',
    });

    const response = await POST(request);
    const data = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
    expect(data.error).toBe('Reset failed');
  });

  it('should handle fetch errors', async () => {
    const { ethers } = require('ethers');
    const mockProvider = {
      getBlockNumber: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(1),
    };
    ethers.JsonRpcProvider.mockReturnValue(mockProvider);

    (global.fetch as jest.Mock).mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network error'));

    const request = new NextRequest('http://localhost:3000/api/reset-anvil', {

    });

    const response = await POST(request);
    const data = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
    expect(data.error).toContain('Network error');
  });
});
```

```typescript
/**

 *
```

```typescript
 */

import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  registerCompany,
  updateCompany,
  setCompanyActive,
  addProduct,

} from '../ecommerce';

  },
}));

describe('getEcommerceContract', () => {
  it('should create contract instance with correct address', () => {
    const originalEnv = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS = '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890';
    
    const mockProvider = {} as any;
    
    expect(() => getEcommerceContract(mockProvider)).not.toThrow();
    
    if (originalEnv) {
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS = originalEnv;
    } else {
      delete process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    }
  });

  it('should throw error if address not configured', () => {
    const originalEnv = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    delete process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    
    const mockProvider = {} as any;
    
    expect(() => getEcommerceContract(mockProvider)).toThrow();
    
    if (originalEnv) {
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS = originalEnv;
    }
  });
});

describe('registerCompany', () => {

    const mockWait = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    const mockTx = {
      hash: '0x1234567890abcdef',
      wait: mockWait,
    };
    
    const mockContract = {

    );

    expect(result.txHash).toBe('0x1234567890abcdef');

      'TAX-123'
    );
  });

  it('should handle registration error', async () => {

    };

      'Test Company',
      '0x0987654321098765432109876543210987654321',
      'TAX-123'
    );

    expect(result.error).toContain('Company already exists');
```

```javascript
// Mock ethers formatUnits and parseUnits
jest.mock('ethers', () => ({
  ...jest.requireActual('ethers'),
  formatUnits: jest.fn((value, decimals = 18) => {
    const bigIntValue = typeof value === 'string' ? BigInt(value) : value;
    const divisor = BigInt(10 ** Number(decimals));
    const quotient = bigIntValue / divisor;
    const remainder = bigIntValue % divisor;
    const decimalsNum = Number(decimals);
    
    if (remainder === BigInt(0)) {
      return quotient.toString();
    }
    
    const remainderStr = remainder.toString().padStart(decimalsNum, '0');
    const trimmedRemainder = remainderStr.replace(/0+$/, '');
    
    if (trimmedRemainder === '') {
      return quotient.toString();
    }
    
    return `${quotient}.${trimmedRemainder}`;
  }),
  parseUnits: jest.fn((value, decimals = 18) => {
    const [integer, decimal = ''] = value.split('.');
    const decimalPadded = decimal.padEnd(decimals, '0').slice(0, decimals);
    return BigInt(integer) * BigInt(10 ** decimals) + BigInt(decimalPadded || '0');
  }),
}))
```

```typescript
import { formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";

export { formatUnits, parseUnits };

/**
 * Format token amount for display
 */
export function formatTokenAmount(amount: bigint | string, decimals: number = 6): string {
  return formatUnits(amount, decimals);
}

/**
 * Format an Ethereum address for display
 */
export function formatAddress(address: string, length: number = 4): string {
  if (!address) return "";
  if (address.length < length * 2 + 2) return address;
  return `${address.substring(0, length + 2)}...${address.substring(address.length - length)}`;
}

/**
 * Validate Ethereum address
 */
export function isValidAddress(address: string): boolean {
  return /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address);
}

/**
 * Format error message
 */
export function formatError(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return error.message;
  }
  if (typeof error === "string") {
    return error;
  }
  return "An unknown error occurred";
}

/**
 * Validate email format
 */
export function isValidEmail(email: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, ReactNode } from "react";
import { ethers } from "ethers";
import { CHAIN_ID, LOCAL_NETWORK } from "@/lib/constants";
import { formatError } from "@/lib/utils";

interface WalletContextType {
  account: string | null;
  chainId: number | null;
  isConnected: boolean;
  isConnecting: boolean;
  provider: ethers.BrowserProvider | null;
  signer: ethers.JsonRpcSigner | null;
  balance: bigint | null;
  connect: () => Promise<void>;
  disconnect: () => void;
  switchNetwork: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshBalance: () => Promise<void>;
  error: string | null;
}

const WalletContext = createContext<WalletContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function WalletProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [account, setAccount] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chainId, setChainId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const [isConnecting, setIsConnecting] = useState(false);
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<ethers.BrowserProvider | null>(null);
  const [signer, setSigner] = useState<ethers.JsonRpcSigner | null>(null);
  const [balance, setBalance] = useState<bigint | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isMetaMaskInstalled = typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.ethereum !== "undefined";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMetaMaskInstalled) return;

    if (!window.ethereum) return;
    const provider = new ethers.BrowserProvider(window.ethereum);
    setProvider(provider);

    checkConnection(provider);

    window.ethereum.on("accountsChanged", handleAccountsChanged);
    window.ethereum.on("chainChanged", handleChainChanged);

    return () => {
      window.ethereum?.removeListener("accountsChanged", handleAccountsChanged);
      window.ethereum?.removeListener("chainChanged", handleChainChanged);
    };
  }, [isMetaMaskInstalled]);

  const checkConnection = async (provider: ethers.BrowserProvider) => {
    try {
      const accounts = await provider.listAccounts();
      if (accounts.length > 0) {
        const network = await provider.getNetwork();
        setChainId(Number(network.chainId));
        setAccount(accounts[0].address);
        setIsConnected(true);
        const signer = await provider.getSigner();
        setSigner(signer);
        await refreshBalance(provider, accounts[0].address);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error checking connection:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleAccountsChanged = (accounts: string[]) => {
    if (accounts.length === 0) {
      disconnect();
    } else {
      setAccount(accounts[0]);
      if (provider) {
        refreshBalance(provider, accounts[0]);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleChainChanged = (chainId: string) => {
    setChainId(parseInt(chainId, 16));
    window.location.reload();
  };

  const refreshBalance = async (providerInstance?: ethers.BrowserProvider, accountAddress?: string) => {
    const prov = providerInstance || provider;
    const addr = accountAddress || account;
    if (!prov || !addr) return;

    try {
      const bal = await prov.getBalance(addr);
      setBalance(bal);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error refreshing balance:", err);
    }
  };

  const connect = async () => {
    if (!isMetaMaskInstalled) {
      setError("MetaMask is not installed. Please install MetaMask to continue.");
      return;
    }

    setIsConnecting(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      if (!window.ethereum) {
        setError("MetaMask is not installed. Please install MetaMask to continue.");
        return;
      }
      const provider = new ethers.BrowserProvider(window.ethereum);
      setProvider(provider);

      await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);

      const network = await provider.getNetwork();
      const currentChainId = Number(network.chainId);

      setChainId(currentChainId);

      if (currentChainId !== CHAIN_ID) {
        await switchNetwork();
      }

      const signer = await provider.getSigner();
      const address = await signer.getAddress();

      setAccount(address);
      setSigner(signer);
      setIsConnected(true);

      await refreshBalance(provider, address);
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = formatError(err);
      setError(errorMessage);
      console.error("Error connecting wallet:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsConnecting(false);
    }
  };

  const disconnect = () => {
    setAccount(null);
    setChainId(null);
    setIsConnected(false);
    setProvider(null);
    setSigner(null);
    setBalance(null);
    setError(null);
  };

  const switchNetwork = async () => {
    if (!isMetaMaskInstalled || !window.ethereum) return;

    try {
      await window.ethereum.request({
        method: "wallet_switchEthereumChain",
        params: [{ chainId: `0x${LOCAL_NETWORK.chainId.toString(16)}` }],
      });
    } catch (switchError: any) {
      if (switchError.code === 4902) {
        try {
          if (!window.ethereum) return;
          await window.ethereum.request({
            method: "wallet_addEthereumChain",
            params: [{
              chainId: `0x${LOCAL_NETWORK.chainId.toString(16)}`,
              chainName: LOCAL_NETWORK.name,
              nativeCurrency: {
                name: "ETH",
                symbol: "ETH",
                decimals: 18,
              },
              rpcUrls: ["http://localhost:8545"],
            }],
          });
        } catch (addError) {
          setError("Failed to add network to MetaMask");
          console.error("Error adding network:", addError);
        }
      } else {
        setError("Failed to switch network");
        console.error("Error switching network:", switchError);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <WalletContext.Provider
      value={{
        account,
        chainId,
        isConnected,
        isConnecting,
        provider,
        signer,
        balance,
        connect,
        disconnect,
        switchNetwork,
        refreshBalance: () => refreshBalance(),
        error,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </WalletContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useWallet() {
  const context = useContext(WalletContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error("useWallet must be used within a WalletProvider");
  }
  return context;
}
```

Creando el archivo `lib/ecommerce.ts` con las funciones necesarias para la tienda online:


```typescript
/**
 * Ecommerce Contract Utilities for Customer Store
 * 
 * Funciones para interactuar con el contrato Ecommerce desde la perspectiva del cliente
 */

import { ethers } from "ethers";
import { ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS } from "./constants";

export interface Customer {
  customerAddress: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  registeredAt: bigint;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Product {
  productId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: bigint;
  stock: bigint;
  ipfsImageHash: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  customerAddress: string;
  totalAmount: bigint;
  timestamp: bigint;
  isPaid: boolean;
  paymentTxHash: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: bigint;
    quantity: bigint;
  }>;
}

export interface CartItem {
  productId: bigint;
  quantity: bigint;
}

export interface OperationResult {
  success: boolean;
  txHash?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface InvoiceResult extends OperationResult {
  invoiceId?: bigint;
}

// Ecommerce ABI (funciones para cliente)
const ECOMMERCE_ABI = [
  // Customer functions
  "function registerCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function updateCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function getCustomer(address customerAddress) external view returns (tuple(address customerAddress, string name, string email, uint256 registeredAt, bool isActive))",
  
  // Product functions
  "function getProduct(uint256 productId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive))",
  "function getAllProducts() external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive)[])",
  "function productsByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
  "function getCompany(uint256 companyId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress))",
  
  // Cart functions
  "function addToCart(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function updateCartQuantity(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function removeFromCart(uint256 productId) external",
  "function clearCart(address customer) external",
  "function getCart(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[])",
  "function getCartTotal(address customer) external view returns (uint256)",
  
  // Invoice functions
  "function createInvoice(address customer, uint256 companyId) external returns (uint256)",
  "function getInvoice(uint256 invoiceId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items))",
  "function getInvoicesByCustomer(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items)[])",
] as const;

/**
 * Get Ecommerce contract instance
 */
export function getEcommerceContract(signerOrProvider: ethers.Provider | ethers.Signer) {
  if (!ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS || ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS === "0x...") {
    throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS not configured");
  }
  return new ethers.Contract(ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS, ECOMMERCE_ABI, signerOrProvider);
}

/**
 * Register a customer
 */
export async function registerCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: registerCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.registerCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer registration failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update customer information
 */
export async function updateCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: updateCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.updateCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer information
 */
export async function getCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string
): Promise<Customer | null> {
  try {
    const customer = await contract.getCustomer(customerAddress);
    // Check if customer exists (registeredAt != 0)
    if (BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()) === BigInt(0)) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      customerAddress: customer.customerAddress,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      registeredAt: BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()),
      isActive: customer.isActive,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If customer doesn't exist, the contract will revert
    if (error.message?.includes("customer does not exist")) {
      return null;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get all products
 */
export async function getAllProducts(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const products = await contract.getAllProducts();
    return products.map((p: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(p.productId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(p.companyId.toString()),
      name: p.name,
      description: p.description,
      price: BigInt(p.price.toString()),
      stock: BigInt(p.stock.toString()),
      ipfsImageHash: p.ipfsImageHash,
      isActive: p.isActive,
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get products by company
 */
export async function getProductsByCompany(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number
): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const productIds = await contract.productsByCompany(companyId);
    const products: Product[] = [];
    
    for (const productId of productIds) {
      try {
        const product = await contract.getProduct(productId);
        products.push({
          productId: BigInt(product.productId.toString()),
          companyId: BigInt(product.companyId.toString()),
          name: product.name,
          description: product.description,
          price: BigInt(product.price.toString()),
          stock: BigInt(product.stock.toString()),
          ipfsImageHash: product.ipfsImageHash,
          isActive: product.isActive,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error getting product ${productId}:`, err);
      }
    }
    
    return products;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products by company:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer's cart
 */
export async function getCart(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<CartItem[]> {
  try {
    const cart = await contract.getCart(customerAddress);
    return cart.map((item: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
      quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting cart:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get cart total
 */
export async function getCartTotal(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<bigint> {
  try {
    const total = await contract.getCartTotal(customerAddress);
    return BigInt(total.toString());
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting cart total:", error);
    return BigInt(0);
  }
}

/**
 * Add item to cart
 */
export async function addToCart(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number,
  quantity: number
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.addToCart(productId, quantity);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to add item to cart" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update cart item quantity
 */
export async function updateCartQuantity(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number,
  quantity: number
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.updateCartQuantity(productId, quantity);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to update cart quantity" };
  }
}

/**
 * Remove item from cart
 */
export async function removeFromCart(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.removeFromCart(productId);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to remove item from cart" };
  }
}

/**
 * Clear cart
 */
export async function clearCart(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.clearCart(customerAddress);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to clear cart" };
  }
}

/**
 * Create invoice from cart
 */
export async function createInvoice(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  companyId: number
): Promise<InvoiceResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.createInvoice(customerAddress, companyId);
    const receipt = await tx.wait();
    // Extract invoiceId from events
    const invoiceId = receipt.logs[0]?.args?.invoiceId || null;
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash, invoiceId: invoiceId ? Number(invoiceId) : undefined };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to create invoice" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get invoices by customer
 */
export async function getInvoicesByCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string
): Promise<Invoice[]> {
  try {
    const invoices = await contract.getInvoicesByCustomer(customerAddress);
    return invoices.map((inv: any) => ({
      invoiceId: BigInt(inv.invoiceId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(inv.companyId.toString()),
      customerAddress: inv.customerAddress,
      totalAmount: BigInt(inv.totalAmount.toString()),
      timestamp: BigInt(inv.timestamp.toString()),
      isPaid: inv.isPaid,
      paymentTxHash: inv.paymentTxHash,
      items: inv.items.map((item: any) => ({
        productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
        quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
      })),
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting invoices:", error);
    return [];
  }
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, registerCustomer, updateCustomer, getCustomer, Customer } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { isValidEmail } from "@/lib/utils";
import { User, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function CustomerForm() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingCustomer, setLoadingCustomer] = useState(false);
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadCustomer();
    } else {
      setCustomer(null);
      setName("");
      setEmail("");
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadCustomer = async () => {
    if (!account || !signer) return;

    setLoadingCustomer(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const customerData = await getCustomer(contract, account);
      
      if (customerData) {
        setCustomer(customerData);
        setName(customerData.name);
        setEmail(customerData.email);
      } else {
        setCustomer(null);
        setName("");
        setEmail("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading customer:", err);
      // Customer doesn't exist, that's okay
      setCustomer(null);
    } finally {
      setLoadingCustomer(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    setValidationError(null);

    if (!name.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Name is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!email.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Email is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
      setValidationError("Invalid email format");
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setError("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    if (!validateForm()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let result;

      if (customer) {
        // Update existing customer
        result = await updateCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      } else {
        // Register new customer
        result = await registerCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      }

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccess(
          customer
            ? "Customer information updated successfully!"
            : "Customer registered successfully!"
        );
        // Reload customer data
        await loadCustomer();
      } else {
        setError(result.error || "Operation failed");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to register or update your customer information.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadingCustomer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading customer information...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <User className="w-6 h-6" />
        Customer {customer ? "Information" : "Registration"}
      </h2>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{success}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {validationError && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300">{validationError}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="name" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Name *
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            id="name"
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            placeholder="Enter your full name"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Email *
          </label>
          <input
            type="email"
            id="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            placeholder="Enter your email address"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
              {customer ? "Updating..." : "Registering..."}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <User className="w-5 h-5" />
              {customer ? "Update Customer" : "Register Customer"}
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, registerCustomer, updateCustomer, getCustomer, Customer } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { isValidEmail } from "@/lib/utils";
import { User, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function CustomerForm() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingCustomer, setLoadingCustomer] = useState(false);
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadCustomer();
    } else {
      setCustomer(null);
      setName("");
      setEmail("");
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadCustomer = async () => {
    if (!account || !signer) return;

    setLoadingCustomer(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const customerData = await getCustomer(contract, account);
      
      if (customerData) {
        setCustomer(customerData);
        setName(customerData.name);
        setEmail(customerData.email);
      } else {
        setCustomer(null);
        setName("");
        setEmail("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading customer:", err);
      // Customer doesn't exist, that's okay
      setCustomer(null);
    } finally {
      setLoadingCustomer(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    setValidationError(null);

    if (!name.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Name is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!email.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Email is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
      setValidationError("Invalid email format");
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setError("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setValidationError(null);
    if (!validateForm()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let result;

      if (customer) {
        // Update existing customer
        result = await updateCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      } else {
        // Register new customer
        result = await registerCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      }

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccess(
          customer
            ? "Customer information updated successfully!"
            : "Customer registered successfully!"
        );
        // Reload customer data
        await loadCustomer();
      } else {
        setError(result.error || "Operation failed");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to register or update your customer information.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadingCustomer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading customer information...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <User className="w-6 h-6" />
        Customer {customer ? "Information" : "Registration"}
      </h2>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{success}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {validationError && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300">{validationError}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="name" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Name *
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            id="name"
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            placeholder="Enter your full name"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Email *
          </label>
          <input
            type="email"
            id="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            placeholder="Enter your email address"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
              {customer ? "Updating..." : "Registering..."}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <User className="w-5 h-5" />
              {customer ? "Update Customer" : "Register Customer"}
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, registerCustomer, updateCustomer, getCustomer, Customer } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { isValidEmail } from "@/lib/utils";
import { User, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function CustomerForm() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingCustomer, setLoadingCustomer] = useState(false);
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadCustomer();
    } else {
      setCustomer(null);
      setName("");
      setEmail("");
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadCustomer = async () => {
    if (!account || !signer) return;

    setLoadingCustomer(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const customerData = await getCustomer(contract, account);
      
      if (customerData) {
        setCustomer(customerData);
        setName(customerData.name);
        setEmail(customerData.email);
      } else {
        setCustomer(null);
        setName("");
        setEmail("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading customer:", err);
      // Customer doesn't exist, that's okay
      setCustomer(null);
    } finally {
      setLoadingCustomer(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    setValidationError(null);

    if (!name || !name.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Name is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!email || !email.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Email is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!isValidEmail(email.trim())) {
      setValidationError("Invalid email format");
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setError("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setValidationError(null);
    if (!validateForm()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let result;

      if (customer) {
        // Update existing customer
        result = await updateCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      } else {
        // Register new customer
        result = await registerCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      }

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccess(
          customer
            ? "Customer information updated successfully!"
            : "Customer registered successfully!"
        );
        // Reload customer data
        await loadCustomer();
      } else {
        setError(result.error || "Operation failed");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to register or update your customer information.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadingCustomer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading customer information...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <User className="w-6 h-6" />
        Customer {customer ? "Information" : "Registration"}
      </h2>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{success}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {validationError && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300">{validationError}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="name" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Name *
          </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setName(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
              placeholder="Enter your full name"
            />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Email *
          </label>
          <input
            type="email"
            id="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            placeholder="Enter your email address"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
              {customer ? "Updating..." : "Registering..."}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <User className="w-5 h-5" />
              {customer ? "Update Customer" : "Register Customer"}
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, registerCustomer, updateCustomer, getCustomer, Customer } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { isValidEmail } from "@/lib/utils";
import { User, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function CustomerForm() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loadingCustomer, setLoadingCustomer] = useState(false);
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadCustomer();
    } else {
      setCustomer(null);
      setName("");
      setEmail("");
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadCustomer = async () => {
    if (!account || !signer) return;

    setLoadingCustomer(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const customerData = await getCustomer(contract, account);
      
      if (customerData) {
        setCustomer(customerData);
        setName(customerData.name);
        setEmail(customerData.email);
      } else {
        setCustomer(null);
        setName("");
        setEmail("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading customer:", err);
      // Customer doesn't exist, that's okay
      setCustomer(null);
    } finally {
      setLoadingCustomer(false);
    }
  };

  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    setValidationError(null);

    if (!name || !name.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Name is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!email || !email.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Email is required");
      return false;
    }

    if (!isValidEmail(email.trim())) {
      setValidationError("Invalid email format");
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setError("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setValidationError(null);
    if (!validateForm()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let result;

      if (customer) {
        // Update existing customer
        result = await updateCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      } else {
        // Register new customer
        result = await registerCustomer(contract, account, name.trim(), email.trim());
      }

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccess(
          customer
            ? "Customer information updated successfully!"
            : "Customer registered successfully!"
        );
        // Reload customer data
        await loadCustomer();
      } else {
        setError(result.error || "Operation failed");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to register or update your customer information.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadingCustomer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading customer information...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <User className="w-6 h-6" />
        Customer {customer ? "Information" : "Registration"}
      </h2>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{success}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {validationError && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300">{validationError}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="name" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Name *
          </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setName(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
              placeholder="Enter your full name"
            />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
            Email *
          </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              id="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setEmail(e.target.value);
                setValidationError(null);
              }}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
              placeholder="Enter your email address"
            />
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
              {customer ? "Updating..." : "Registering..."}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <User className="w-5 h-5" />
              {customer ? "Update Customer" : "Register Customer"}
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

La validación HTML5 del `input type="email"` interfería con la validación personalizada.

### Solución
Se agregó `noValidate` al formulario para usar solo la validación personalizada con `isValidEmail`.

```typescriptreact
const mockEcommerceLib = ecommerceLib as jest.Mocked<typeof ecommerceLib>;

  const mockGetProductsByCompany = jest.fn();
  const mockAddToCart = jest.fn();
  const mockGetEcommerceContract = jest.fn();

  const mockProducts = [
    {
      productId: BigInt(1),
      companyId: BigInt(1),
      name: 'Product 1',
      description: 'Description 1',

      productId: BigInt(2),

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    
    mockEcommerceLib.getAllProducts = mockGetAllProducts;
    mockEcommerceLib.getProductsByCompany = mockGetProductsByCompany;
    mockEcommerceLib.addToCart = mockAddToCart;
    mockEcommerceLib.getEcommerceContract = mockGetEcommerceContract;
```

El test falla (RED). Implementando ProductList (GREEN):


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, getAllProducts, getProductsByCompany, addToCart, Product } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Package, Loader2, ShoppingCart, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

interface ProductListProps {
  companyId?: number; // Optional: filter by company
}

export function ProductList({ companyId }: ProductListProps) {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [addingToCart, setAddingToCart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadProducts();
    } else {
      setProducts([]);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer, companyId]);

  const loadProducts = async () => {
    if (!signer) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let productsData: Product[];

      if (companyId !== undefined) {
        productsData = await getProductsByCompany(contract, companyId);
      } else {
        productsData = await getAllProducts(contract);
      }

      // Filter only active products
      const activeProducts = productsData.filter((p) => p.isActive);
      setProducts(activeProducts);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading products:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load products");
      setProducts([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddToCart = async (productId: number, quantity: number = 1) => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setAddingToCart(productId);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await addToCart(contract, productId, quantity);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Product added to cart successfully!`);
        // Clear success message after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to add product to cart");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to add product to cart");
    } finally {
      setAddingToCart(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view products.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Filter out products with zero stock (optional: could show them as "out of stock")
  const availableProducts = products.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
  const outOfStockProducts = products.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
        Products
      </h2>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {availableProducts.length === 0 && outOfStockProducts.length === 0 && (
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
          <Package className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p>No products available</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {availableProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {availableProducts.map((product) => (
            <div
              key={Number(product.productId)}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
            >
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
                {product.name}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4 line-clamp-2">
                {product.description}
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Price:</span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                    €{formatTokenAmount(product.price)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Stock:</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                    {product.stock.toString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleAddToCart(Number(product.productId), 1)}
                disabled={addingToCart === Number(product.productId)}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                {addingToCart === Number(product.productId) ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    Adding...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Add to Cart
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {outOfStockProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-6">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">Out of Stock</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {outOfStockProducts.map((product) => (
              <div
                key={Number(product.productId)}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 opacity-60"
              >
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
                  {product.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4 line-clamp-2">
                  {product.description}
                </p>
                <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Price:</span>
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                      €{formatTokenAmount(product.price)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 rounded-lg text-center font-medium">
                  Out of Stock
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * TDD Tests for ProductList Component
 * 
 * RED → GREEN → REFACTOR
 */

import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { ProductList } from '../ProductList';
import { useWallet } from '@/contexts/WalletContext';
import * as ecommerceLib from '@/lib/ecommerce';

jest.mock('@/contexts/WalletContext');
jest.mock('@/lib/ecommerce');

const mockUseWallet = useWallet as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useWallet>;
const mockEcommerceLib = ecommerceLib as jest.Mocked<typeof ecommerceLib>;

describe('ProductList', () => {
  const mockGetAllProducts = jest.fn();
  const mockGetProductsByCompany = jest.fn();
  const mockAddToCart = jest.fn();
  const mockGetEcommerceContract = jest.fn();

  const mockProducts = [
    {
      productId: BigInt(1),
      companyId: BigInt(1),
      name: 'Product 1',
      description: 'Description 1',
      price: BigInt('100000000'), // 100 EURT
      stock: BigInt(10),
      ipfsImageHash: 'QmHash1',
      isActive: true,
    },
    {
      productId: BigInt(2),
      companyId: BigInt(1),
      name: 'Product 2',
      description: 'Description 2',
      price: BigInt('50000000'), // 50 EURT
      stock: BigInt(5),
      ipfsImageHash: 'QmHash2',
      isActive: true,
    },
    {
      productId: BigInt(3),
      companyId: BigInt(2),
      name: 'Product 3',
      description: 'Description 3',
      price: BigInt('200000000'), // 200 EURT
      stock: BigInt(0),
      ipfsImageHash: 'QmHash3',
      isActive: true,
    },
```
