Implementando ShoppingCart:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getCart,
  getCartTotal,
  updateCartQuantity,
  removeFromCart,
  clearCart,
  getProduct,
  CartItem,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  ShoppingBag,
  Loader2,
  Trash2,
  X,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

export function ShoppingCart() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [cartItems, setCartItems] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [cartTotal, setCartTotal] = useState<bigint>(BigInt(0));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [quantityInputs, setQuantityInputs] = useState<Map<number, number>>(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadCart();
    } else {
      setCartItems([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
      setCartTotal(BigInt(0));
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadCart = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
        getCart(contract, account),
        getCartTotal(contract, account),
      ]);

      setCartItems(items);
      setCartTotal(total);

      // Load product details for each cart item
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const quantityMap = new Map<number, number>();

      for (const item of items) {
        const productId = Number(item.productId);
        try {
          const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
          productsMap.set(productId, product);
          quantityMap.set(productId, Number(item.quantity));
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
        }
      }

      setProducts(productsMap);
      setQuantityInputs(quantityMap);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading cart:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load cart");
      setCartItems([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
      setCartTotal(BigInt(0));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateQuantity = async (productId: number, newQuantity: number) => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    const product = products.get(productId);
    if (!product) {
      setErrorMessage("Product not found");
      return;
    }

    // Validate quantity against stock
    if (newQuantity > Number(product.stock)) {
      setErrorMessage(`Insufficient stock. Available: ${product.stock.toString()}`);
      return;
    }

    if (newQuantity <= 0) {
      setErrorMessage("Quantity must be greater than zero");
      return;
    }

    setUpdating(productId);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await updateCartQuantity(contract, productId, newQuantity);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Quantity updated successfully!`);
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
        await loadCart(); // Reload cart to get updated data
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to update quantity");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to update quantity");
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveItem = async (productId: number) => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setUpdating(productId);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await removeFromCart(contract, productId);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Product removed from cart!`);
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
        await loadCart(); // Reload cart to get updated data
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to remove item");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to remove item");
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleClearCart = async () => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your cart?")) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await clearCart(contract, account);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Cart cleared successfully!`);
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
        await loadCart(); // Reload cart
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to clear cart");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to clear cart");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuantityChange = (productId: number, value: string) => {
    const numValue = parseInt(value, 10);
    if (isNaN(numValue)) {
      return;
    }
    setQuantityInputs((prev) => {
      const newMap = new Map(prev);
      newMap.set(productId, numValue);
      return newMap;
    });
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view your shopping cart.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading cart...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (cartItems.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShoppingBag className="w-6 h-6" />
          Shopping Cart
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <ShoppingBag className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">Your cart is empty</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Add products to your cart to get started</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShoppingBag className="w-6 h-6" />
          Shopping Cart
        </h2>
        {cartItems.length > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={handleClearCart}
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            Clear Cart
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {cartItems.map((item) => {
          const productId = Number(item.productId);
          const product = products.get(productId);
          const currentQuantity = quantityInputs.get(productId) || Number(item.quantity);
          const isUpdating = updating === productId;

          if (!product) {
            return (
              <div
                key={productId}
                className="p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
              >
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                  Loading product {productId}...
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          }

          const itemTotal = product.price * BigInt(item.quantity);

          return (
            <div
              key={productId}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
                    {product.name}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mb-4 line-clamp-2">
                    {product.description}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Price: </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                        €{formatTokenAmount(product.price)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Stock: </span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        {product.stock.toString()}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <label className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Quantity:</label>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleQuantityChange(productId, (currentQuantity - 1).toString())
                          }
                          disabled={isUpdating || currentQuantity <= 1}
                          className="p-1 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          <Minus className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max={product.stock.toString()}
                          value={currentQuantity}
                          onChange={(e) => handleQuantityChange(productId, e.target.value)}
                          disabled={isUpdating}
                          className="w-16 px-2 py-1 text-center border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white disabled:opacity-50"
                        />
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleQuantityChange(productId, (currentQuantity + 1).toString())
                          }
                          disabled={
                            isUpdating || currentQuantity >= Number(product.stock)
                          }
                          className="p-1 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      {currentQuantity !== Number(item.quantity) && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleUpdateQuantity(productId, currentQuantity)}
                          disabled={isUpdating}
                          className="px-3 py-1 text-sm bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          {isUpdating ? (
                            <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                          ) : (
                            "Update"
                          )}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Item Total: </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                        €{formatTokenAmount(itemTotal)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleRemoveItem(productId)}
                  disabled={isUpdating}
                  className="p-2 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 rounded-lg transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  title="Remove from cart"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Total:</span>
          <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
            €{formatTokenAmount(cartTotal)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);

      provider: {} as any,

      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '3');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /update/i }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/failed to update/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should show success message when quantity is updated', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([mockCartItems[0]]);
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);
    mockUpdateCartQuantity.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, txHash: '0x123' });

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '3');
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /update/i }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/updated/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });
});
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * TDD Tests for ShoppingCart Component
 * 
 * RED → GREEN → REFACTOR
 */

import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

    mockEcommerceLib.clearCart = mockClearCart;
    mockEcommerceLib.getProduct = mockGetProduct;

      balance: null,

      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),

    await waitFor(() => {
      const updateButton = screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /update/i });
      expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const updateButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /update/i });
    await user.click(updateButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockUpdateCartQuantity).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.any(Object), // contract
        1, // productId
        3 // quantity
      );
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should remove item from cart', async () => {

  });

    mockGetProduct
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[1])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[2]);

    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValueOnce(mockCartItems); // Initial load

      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockClearCart).toHaveBeenCalled();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

    expect(mockUpdateCartQuantity).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
```

```typescriptreact
    // Setup chained mocks

      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve([mockCartItems[0]]); // Initial load
      }
      return Promise.resolve([{ productId: BigInt(1), quantity: BigInt(3) }]); // After update

    mockGetCartTotal.mockImplementation(() => {
```

```typescriptreact
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { ShoppingCart } from '../ShoppingCart';
import { useWallet } from '@/contexts/WalletContext';
import * as ecommerceLib from '@/lib/ecommerce';

jest.mock('@/contexts/WalletContext');
jest.mock('@/lib/ecommerce');

const mockUseWallet = useWallet as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useWallet>;
const mockEcommerceLib = ecommerceLib as jest.Mocked<typeof ecommerceLib>;

describe('ShoppingCart', () => {
  const mockGetCart = jest.fn();
  const mockGetCartTotal = jest.fn();
  const mockUpdateCartQuantity = jest.fn();
  const mockRemoveFromCart = jest.fn();
  const mockClearCart = jest.fn();
  const mockGetProduct = jest.fn();
  const mockGetEcommerceContract = jest.fn();

  const mockCartItems = [
    {
      productId: BigInt(1),
      quantity: BigInt(2),
    },
    {
      productId: BigInt(2),
      quantity: BigInt(1),
    },
  ];

  const mockProducts = {
    1: {
      productId: BigInt(1),
      companyId: BigInt(1),
      name: 'Product 1',
      description: 'Description 1',
      price: BigInt('100000000'), // 100 EURT
      stock: BigInt(10),
      ipfsImageHash: 'QmHash1',
      isActive: true,
    },
    2: {
      productId: BigInt(2),
      companyId: BigInt(1),
      name: 'Product 2',
      description: 'Description 2',
      price: BigInt('50000000'), // 50 EURT
      stock: BigInt(5),
      ipfsImageHash: 'QmHash2',
      isActive: true,
    },
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    
    mockEcommerceLib.getCart = mockGetCart;
    mockEcommerceLib.getCartTotal = mockGetCartTotal;
    mockEcommerceLib.updateCartQuantity = mockUpdateCartQuantity;
    mockEcommerceLib.removeFromCart = mockRemoveFromCart;
    mockEcommerceLib.clearCart = mockClearCart;
    mockEcommerceLib.getProduct = mockGetProduct;
    mockEcommerceLib.getEcommerceContract = mockGetEcommerceContract;
    
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([]);
    mockGetCartTotal.mockResolvedValue(BigInt(0));
    mockGetEcommerceContract.mockReturnValue({} as any);
  });

  it('should render shopping cart', async () => {
    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/shopping cart/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it('should show wallet not connected message', () => {
    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: null,
      isConnected: false,
      signer: null,
      provider: null,
      chainId: null,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: null,
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    expect(screen.getByText(/please connect your wallet/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('should load and display cart items', async () => {
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue(mockCartItems);
    mockGetProduct
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[1])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[2]);

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should display cart item details (name, quantity, price)', async () => {
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([mockCartItems[0]]);
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/2/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); // Quantity
      expect(screen.getByText(/100/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); // Price
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should display cart total', async () => {
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue(mockCartItems);
    mockGetCartTotal.mockResolvedValue(BigInt('250000000')); // 250 EURT
    mockGetProduct
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[1])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[2]);

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/250/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); // Total
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should show empty state when cart is empty', async () => {
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([]);

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/cart is empty/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should update cart item quantity', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    // Setup chained mocks
    let callCount = 0;
    mockGetCart.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve([mockCartItems[0]]); // Initial load
      }
      return Promise.resolve([{ productId: BigInt(1), quantity: BigInt(3) }]); // After update
    });
    
    callCount = 0;
    mockGetCartTotal.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve(BigInt('200000000'));
      }
      return Promise.resolve(BigInt('300000000'));
    });
    
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);
    mockUpdateCartQuantity.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, txHash: '0x123' });

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
```

```typescriptreact
    // Wait for Update button to appear (it appears when quantity changes)
    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '3');

    // Wait for Update button to appear
    await waitFor(() => {
      const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
      const updateButton = updateButtons.find(btn => btn.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('update'));
      expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    const updateButton = updateButtons.find(btn => btn.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('update'));
    expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(updateButton!);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockUpdateCartQuantity).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.any(Object), // contract
        1, // productId
        3 // quantity
      );
    }, { timeout: 3000 });
  });

  it('should remove item from cart', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    // Setup chained mocks
    let callCount = 0;
    mockGetCart.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve([mockCartItems[0]]); // Initial load
      }
      return Promise.resolve([]); // After remove
    });
    
    callCount = 0;
    mockGetCartTotal.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve(BigInt('200000000'));
      }
      return Promise.resolve(BigInt(0));
    });
    
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);
    mockRemoveFromCart.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, txHash: '0x123' });

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const removeButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /remove/i });
    await user.click(removeButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockRemoveFromCart).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.any(Object), // contract
        1 // productId
      );
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should clear cart', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    
    // Mock window.confirm to return true
    window.confirm = jest.fn(() => true);

    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue(mockCartItems);
    mockGetProduct
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[1])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockProducts[2]);
    mockClearCart.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, txHash: '0x123' });
    // Mock reload after clear
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValueOnce(mockCartItems); // Initial load
    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValueOnce([]); // After clear

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const clearButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /clear cart/i });
    await user.click(clearButton);

    // Should call confirm
    expect(window.confirm).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Are you sure you want to clear your cart?');

    // Should call clearCart after confirmation
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockClearCart).toHaveBeenCalled();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should validate quantity against stock', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([mockCartItems[0]]);
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]); // stock: 10

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '15'); // More than stock (10)
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /update/i }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/insufficient stock/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    expect(mockUpdateCartQuantity).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('should show loading state while loading cart', () => {
    mockGetCart.mockImplementation(() => new Promise(resolve => {
      setTimeout(() => resolve(mockCartItems), 100);
    }));

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    expect(screen.getByText(/loading/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('should show error message when loading cart fails', async () => {
    mockGetCart.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Failed to load cart'));

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',

      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,

      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/error/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });
  });

  it('should handle update quantity error', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    mockGetCart.mockResolvedValue([mockCartItems[0]]);
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);
    mockGetCartTotal.mockResolvedValue(BigInt('200000000'));
    mockUpdateCartQuantity.mockResolvedValue({
      success: false,
      error: 'Failed to update quantity',
    });

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '3');

    // Wait for Update button
    await waitFor(() => {
      const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
      const updateButton = updateButtons.find(btn => btn.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('update'));
      expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    const updateButton = updateButtons.find(btn => btn.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('update'));
    expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(updateButton!);

    await waitFor(() => {
      const errorMessages = screen.getAllByText(/failed to update quantity/i);
      expect(errorMessages.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }, { timeout: 3000 });
  });

  it('should show success message when quantity is updated', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();

    // Setup chained mocks
    let callCount = 0;
    mockGetCart.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {
        return Promise.resolve([mockCartItems[0]]); // Initial load
      }
      return Promise.resolve([{ productId: BigInt(1), quantity: BigInt(3) }]); // After update
    });
    
    callCount = 0;
    mockGetCartTotal.mockImplementation(() => {
      callCount++;
      if (callCount === 1) {

      }
      return Promise.resolve(BigInt('300000000'));
    });
    
    mockGetProduct.mockResolvedValue(mockProducts[1]);
    mockUpdateCartQuantity.mockResolvedValue({ success: true, txHash: '0x123' });

    mockUseWallet.mockReturnValue({
      account: '0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890',
      isConnected: true,
      signer: {} as any,
      provider: {} as any,
      chainId: 31337,
      isConnecting: false,
      balance: BigInt('1000000000000000000'),
      connect: jest.fn(),
      disconnect: jest.fn(),
      switchNetwork: jest.fn(),
      refreshBalance: jest.fn(),
      error: null,
    });

    render(<ShoppingCart />);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Product 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }, { timeout: 2000 });

    const quantityInput = screen.getByDisplayValue('2');
    await user.clear(quantityInput);
    await user.type(quantityInput, '3');

    // Wait for Update button
    await waitFor(() => {
      const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');

    const updateButtons = screen.getAllByRole('button');
    const updateButton = updateButtons.find(btn => btn.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('update'));
    expect(updateButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(updateButton!);

    await waitFor(() => {
      // The message says "Quantity updated successfully!"
      const successMessages = screen.getAllByText(/quantity updated/i);
      expect(successMessages.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }, { timeout: 3000 });
  });
});
```

2. Gestión de cantidades:
   - Modificar cantidad de cada item
   - Validación contra stock disponible
   - Botones +/- para ajustar cantidad
   - Botón "Update" cuando la cantidad cambia
   - Validación de cantidades mínimas y máximas

3. Eliminación de items:
   - Botón para remover items individuales
   - Confirmación antes de eliminar

4. Limpiar carrito:
   - Botón "Clear Cart" con confirmación
   - Limpieza completa del carrito

5. Estados y UX:
   - Estado de carga mientras se carga el carrito
   - Manejo de errores
   - Mensajes de éxito/error
   - Estados de actualización por item
   - Recarga automática después de cambios

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getCart,
  getCartTotal,
  getCompanies,
  createInvoice,
  Company,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  ShoppingBag,
} from "lucide-react";

export function CreateInvoice() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [companies, setCompanies] = useState<Company[]>([]);
  const [selectedCompanyId, setSelectedCompanyId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [cartTotal, setCartTotal] = useState<bigint>(BigInt(0));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [invoiceId, setInvoiceId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadData();
    } else {
      setCompanies([]);
      setCartTotal(BigInt(0));
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const [companiesData, total] = await Promise.all([
        getCompanies(contract),
        getCartTotal(contract, account),
      ]);

      // Filter only active companies
      const activeCompanies = companiesData.filter((c) => c.isActive);
      setCompanies(activeCompanies);
      setCartTotal(total);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading data:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load data");
      setCompanies([]);
      setCartTotal(BigInt(0));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedCompanyId) {
      setErrorMessage("Please select a company");
      return;
    }

    // Check if cart is empty
    if (cartTotal === BigInt(0)) {
      setErrorMessage("Your cart is empty. Add products to your cart first.");
      return;
    }

    setCreating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    setInvoiceId(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await createInvoice(contract, account, selectedCompanyId);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Invoice created successfully!`);
        if (result.invoiceId) {
          setInvoiceId(result.invoiceId);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          setSuccessMessage(null);
          setInvoiceId(null);
        }, 5000);
        // Optionally reload cart total (it should be 0 after invoice creation)
        await loadData();
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to create invoice");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to create invoice");
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to create an invoice.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (cartTotal === BigInt(0)) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Create Invoice
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <ShoppingBag className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">Your cart is empty</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Add products to your cart before creating an invoice</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
        Create Invoice
      </h2>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
            {invoiceId && (
              <p className="text-xs text-green-600 dark:text-green-500 mt-1">
                Invoice ID: {invoiceId}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg p-6 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="company" className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2">
              Select Company *
            </label>
            <select
              id="company"
              value={selectedCompanyId || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedCompanyId(e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value, 10) : null)}
              required
              disabled={creating}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <option value="">-- Select a company --</option>
              {companies.map((company) => (
                <option key={Number(company.companyId)} value={Number(company.companyId)}>
                  {company.name} (ID: {company.companyId.toString()})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Cart Total:</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                €{formatTokenAmount(cartTotal)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={creating || !selectedCompanyId || cartTotal === BigInt(0)}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {creating ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
                Creating Invoice...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
                Create Invoice
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Agregando la función `getCompanies` a `ecommerce.ts`:


```typescript
/**
 * Ecommerce Contract Utilities for Customer Store
 * 
 * Funciones para interactuar con el contrato Ecommerce desde la perspectiva del cliente
 */

import { ethers } from "ethers";
import { ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS } from "./constants";

export interface Customer {
  customerAddress: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  registeredAt: bigint;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Product {
  productId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: bigint;
  stock: bigint;
  ipfsImageHash: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  customerAddress: string;
  totalAmount: bigint;
  timestamp: bigint;
  isPaid: boolean;
  paymentTxHash: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: bigint;
    quantity: bigint;
  }>;
}

export interface CartItem {
  productId: bigint;
  quantity: bigint;
}

export interface OperationResult {
  success: boolean;
  txHash?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface InvoiceResult extends OperationResult {
  invoiceId?: number;
}

export interface Company {
  companyId: bigint;
  owner: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

// Ecommerce ABI (funciones para cliente)
const ECOMMERCE_ABI = [
  // Customer functions
  "function registerCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function updateCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function getCustomer(address customerAddress) external view returns (tuple(address customerAddress, string name, string email, uint256 registeredAt, bool isActive))",
  
  // Product functions
  "function getProduct(uint256 productId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive))",
  "function getAllProducts() external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive)[])",
  "function productsByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
  "function getCompany(uint256 companyId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress))",
  
  // Cart functions
  "function addToCart(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function updateCartQuantity(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function removeFromCart(uint256 productId) external",
  "function clearCart(address customer) external",
  "function getCart(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[])",
  "function getCartTotal(address customer) external view returns (uint256)",
  
  // Invoice functions
  "function createInvoice(address customer, uint256 companyId) external returns (uint256)",
  "function getInvoice(uint256 invoiceId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items))",
  "function getInvoicesByCustomer(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items)[])",
] as const;

/**
 * Get Ecommerce contract instance
 */
export function getEcommerceContract(signerOrProvider: ethers.Provider | ethers.Signer) {
  if (!ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS || ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS === "0x...") {
    throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS not configured");
  }
  return new ethers.Contract(ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS, ECOMMERCE_ABI, signerOrProvider);
}

/**
 * Register a customer
 */
export async function registerCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: registerCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.registerCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer registration failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update customer information
 */
export async function updateCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: updateCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.updateCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer information
 */
export async function getCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string
): Promise<Customer | null> {
  try {
    const customer = await contract.getCustomer(customerAddress);
    // Check if customer exists (registeredAt != 0)
    if (BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()) === BigInt(0)) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      customerAddress: customer.customerAddress,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      registeredAt: BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()),
      isActive: customer.isActive,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If customer doesn't exist, the contract will revert
    if (error.message?.includes("customer does not exist")) {
      return null;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get all products
 */
export async function getAllProducts(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const products = await contract.getAllProducts();
    return products.map((p: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(p.productId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(p.companyId.toString()),
      name: p.name,
      description: p.description,
      price: BigInt(p.price.toString()),
      stock: BigInt(p.stock.toString()),
      ipfsImageHash: p.ipfsImageHash,
      isActive: p.isActive,
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get products by company
 */
export async function getProductsByCompany(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number
): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const productIds = await contract.productsByCompany(companyId);
    const products: Product[] = [];
    
    for (const productId of productIds) {
      try {
        const product = await contract.getProduct(productId);
        products.push({
          productId: BigInt(product.productId.toString()),
          companyId: BigInt(product.companyId.toString()),
          name: product.name,
          description: product.description,
          price: BigInt(product.price.toString()),
          stock: BigInt(product.stock.toString()),
          ipfsImageHash: product.ipfsImageHash,
          isActive: product.isActive,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error getting product ${productId}:`, err);
      }
    }
    
    return products;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products by company:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer's cart
 */
export async function getCart(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<CartItem[]> {
  try {
    const cart = await contract.getCart(customerAddress);
    return cart.map((item: any) => ({
```

```typescript
/**
 * Ecommerce Contract Utilities for Customer Store
 * 
 * Funciones para interactuar con el contrato Ecommerce desde la perspectiva del cliente
 */

import { ethers } from "ethers";
import { ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS } from "./constants";

export interface Customer {
  customerAddress: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  registeredAt: bigint;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Product {
  productId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: bigint;
  stock: bigint;
  ipfsImageHash: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceId: bigint;
  companyId: bigint;
  customerAddress: string;
  totalAmount: bigint;
  timestamp: bigint;
  isPaid: boolean;
  paymentTxHash: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: bigint;
    quantity: bigint;
  }>;
}

export interface CartItem {
  productId: bigint;
  quantity: bigint;
}

export interface OperationResult {
  success: boolean;
  txHash?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface InvoiceResult extends OperationResult {
  invoiceId?: number;
}

export interface Company {
  companyId: bigint;
  owner: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

// Ecommerce ABI (funciones para cliente)
const ECOMMERCE_ABI = [
  // Customer functions
  "function registerCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function updateCustomer(string memory name, string memory email) external",
  "function getCustomer(address customerAddress) external view returns (tuple(address customerAddress, string name, string email, uint256 registeredAt, bool isActive))",
  
  // Product functions
  "function getProduct(uint256 productId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive))",
  "function getAllProducts() external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 companyId, string name, string description, uint256 price, uint256 stock, string ipfsImageHash, bool isActive)[])",
  "function productsByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
  "function getCompany(uint256 companyId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress))",
  "function getAllCompanies() external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress)[])",
  
  // Cart functions
  "function addToCart(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function updateCartQuantity(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity) external",
  "function removeFromCart(uint256 productId) external",
  "function clearCart(address customer) external",
  "function getCart(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[])",
  "function getCartTotal(address customer) external view returns (uint256)",
  
  // Invoice functions
  "function createInvoice(address customer, uint256 companyId) external returns (uint256)",
  "function getInvoice(uint256 invoiceId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items))",
  "function getInvoicesByCustomer(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items)[])",
] as const;

/**
 * Get Ecommerce contract instance
 */
export function getEcommerceContract(signerOrProvider: ethers.Provider | ethers.Signer) {
  if (!ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS || ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS === "0x...") {
    throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS not configured");
  }
  return new ethers.Contract(ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS, ECOMMERCE_ABI, signerOrProvider);
}

/**
 * Register a customer
 */
export async function registerCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: registerCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.registerCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer registration failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update customer information
 */
export async function updateCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: updateCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.updateCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer information
 */
export async function getCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string
): Promise<Customer | null> {
  try {
    const customer = await contract.getCustomer(customerAddress);
    // Check if customer exists (registeredAt != 0)
    if (BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()) === BigInt(0)) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      customerAddress: customer.customerAddress,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      registeredAt: BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()),
      isActive: customer.isActive,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If customer doesn't exist, the contract will revert
    if (error.message?.includes("customer does not exist")) {
      return null;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get all products
 */
export async function getAllProducts(contract: ethers.Contract): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const products = await contract.getAllProducts();
    return products.map((p: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(p.productId.toString()),
      companyId: BigInt(p.companyId.toString()),
      name: p.name,
      description: p.description,
      price: BigInt(p.price.toString()),
      stock: BigInt(p.stock.toString()),
      ipfsImageHash: p.ipfsImageHash,
      isActive: p.isActive,
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get products by company
 */
export async function getProductsByCompany(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  companyId: number
): Promise<Product[]> {
  try {
    const productIds = await contract.productsByCompany(companyId);
    const products: Product[] = [];
    
    for (const productId of productIds) {
      try {
        const product = await contract.getProduct(productId);
        products.push({
          productId: BigInt(product.productId.toString()),
          companyId: BigInt(product.companyId.toString()),
          name: product.name,
          description: product.description,
          price: BigInt(product.price.toString()),
          stock: BigInt(product.stock.toString()),
          ipfsImageHash: product.ipfsImageHash,
          isActive: product.isActive,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error getting product ${productId}:`, err);
      }
    }
    
    return products;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products by company:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer's cart
 */
export async function getCart(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<CartItem[]> {
  try {
    const cart = await contract.getCart(customerAddress);
    return cart.map((item: any) => ({
      productId: BigInt(item.productId.toString()),
      quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting cart:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**

 */
export async function getCartTotal(contract: ethers.Contract, customerAddress: string): Promise<bigint> {
  try {
    const total = await contract.getCartTotal(customerAddress);
    return BigInt(total.toString());
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting cart total:", error);
    return BigInt(0);
  }
}

/**
 * Add item to cart
 */
export async function addToCart(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  productId: number,
  quantity: number
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    const tx = await contract.addToCart(productId, quantity);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to add item to cart" };
  }
}

 */
export async function updateCartQuantity(

): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {

    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };

    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Failed to clear cart" };

}

/**

 */

): Promise<InvoiceResult> {

    const invoiceId = receipt.logs[0]?.args?.invoiceId || null;

): Promise<Invoice[]> {

        quantity: BigInt(item.quantity.toString()),
      })),
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting invoices:", error);
    return [];
  }
}
```

```typescript
  "function getCustomer(address customerAddress) external view returns (tuple(address customerAddress, string name, string email, uint256 registeredAt, bool isActive))",
  
  // Product functions

  "function productsByCompany(uint256) external view returns (uint256[])",
  "function getCompany(uint256 companyId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress))",
  "function getAllCompanies() external view returns (tuple(uint256 companyId, string name, address companyAddress, string taxId, bool isActive, address ownerAddress)[])",

  "function clearCart(address customer) external",
  "function getCart(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[])",
  "function getCartTotal(address customer) external view returns (uint256)",
  
  // Invoice functions

  "function getInvoice(uint256 invoiceId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items))",
  "function getInvoicesByCustomer(address customer) external view returns (tuple(uint256 invoiceId, uint256 companyId, address customerAddress, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 timestamp, bool isPaid, bytes32 paymentTxHash, tuple(uint256 productId, uint256 quantity)[] items)[])",
] as const;

/**
 * Get Ecommerce contract instance
 */
export function getEcommerceContract(signerOrProvider: ethers.Provider | ethers.Signer) {
  if (!ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS || ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS === "0x...") {
    throw new Error("NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS not configured");
  }
  return new ethers.Contract(ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS, ECOMMERCE_ABI, signerOrProvider);
}

/**
 * Register a customer
 */
export async function registerCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: registerCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.registerCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer registration failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Update customer information
 */
export async function updateCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string,
  name: string,
  email: string
): Promise<OperationResult> {
  try {
    // Note: updateCustomer uses msg.sender, so we need to call it from the customer's wallet
    const tx = await contract.updateCustomer(name, email);
    await tx.wait();
    return { success: true, txHash: tx.hash };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "Customer update failed" };
  }
}

/**
 * Get customer information
 */
export async function getCustomer(
  contract: ethers.Contract,
  customerAddress: string
): Promise<Customer | null> {
  try {
    const customer = await contract.getCustomer(customerAddress);
    // Check if customer exists (registeredAt != 0)
    if (BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()) === BigInt(0)) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      customerAddress: customer.customerAddress,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      registeredAt: BigInt(customer.registeredAt.toString()),
      isActive: customer.isActive,
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If customer doesn't exist, the contract will revert
    if (error.message?.includes("customer does not exist")) {
      return null;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

    return products.map((p: any) => ({

      companyId: BigInt(p.companyId.toString()),
      name: p.name,
      description: p.description,
      price: BigInt(p.price.toString()),
      stock: BigInt(p.stock.toString()),
      ipfsImageHash: p.ipfsImageHash,

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting products:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

  try {
    const companies = await contract.getAllCompanies();
    return companies.map((company: any) => ({
      companyId: BigInt(company.companyId.toString()),
      owner: company.ownerAddress || company.owner,
      name: company.name,
      email: company.taxId || "", // Using taxId as email placeholder if needed
      isActive: company.isActive,
    }));
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Error getting companies:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

    return [];
```
