```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, memo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, getAllProducts, getProductsByCompany, addToCart, Product } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Package, Loader2, ShoppingCart, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Filter } from "lucide-react";
import { ProductSkeleton } from "./LoadingSkeleton";
import { EmptyState } from "./EmptyState";
import { ProductCard } from "./ProductCard";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";

interface ProductListProps {
  companyId?: number; // Optional: filter by company
}

export function ProductList({ companyId }: ProductListProps) {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [addingToCart, setAddingToCart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [priceFilter, setPriceFilter] = useState<"all" | "low" | "medium" | "high">("all");
  const [stockFilter, setStockFilter] = useState<"all" | "in-stock" | "out-of-stock">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(12);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadProducts();
    } else {
      setProducts([]);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer, companyId]);

  const loadProducts = async () => {
    if (!signer) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let productsData: Product[];

      if (companyId !== undefined) {
        productsData = await getProductsByCompany(contract, companyId);
      } else {
        productsData = await getAllProducts(contract);
      }

      // Filter only active products
      const activeProducts = productsData.filter((p) => p.isActive);
      setProducts(activeProducts);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading products:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load products");
      setProducts([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddToCart = useCallback(async (productId: number, quantity: number = 1) => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setAddingToCart(productId);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await addToCart(contract, productId, quantity);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Product added to cart successfully!`);
        // Clear success message after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to add product to cart");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to add product to cart");
    } finally {
      setAddingToCart(null);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view products.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Memoize filtered and searched products
  const { filteredProducts, availableProducts, outOfStockProducts } = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = products;

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (p) =>
          p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          (p.description && p.description.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      );
    }

    // Price filter
    if (priceFilter !== "all") {
      const avgPrice = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.price), 0) / filtered.length || 0;
      if (priceFilter === "low") {
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.price) < avgPrice * 0.5);
      } else if (priceFilter === "medium") {
        filtered = filtered.filter(
          (p) => Number(p.price) >= avgPrice * 0.5 && Number(p.price) <= avgPrice * 1.5
        );
      } else if (priceFilter === "high") {
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.price) > avgPrice * 1.5);
      }
    }

    // Stock filter
    if (stockFilter === "in-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    } else if (stockFilter === "out-of-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    }

    const available = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    const outOfStock = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    
    return { filteredProducts: filtered, availableProducts: available, outOfStockProducts: outOfStock };
  }, [products, searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredProducts.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedAvailableProducts = availableProducts.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  const paginatedOutOfStockProducts = outOfStockProducts.slice(0, itemsPerPage - paginatedAvailableProducts.length);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);


  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          Products
        </h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <ProductSkeleton key={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
        Products
      </h2>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {availableProducts.length === 0 && outOfStockProducts.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyState type="products" />
      )}

      {availableProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {availableProducts.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard
              key={Number(product.productId)}
              product={product}
              onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
              isAdding={addingToCart === Number(product.productId)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {outOfStockProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-6">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">Out of Stock</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {outOfStockProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard
                key={Number(product.productId)}
                product={product}
                onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
                isAdding={false}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
      } else if (priceFilter === "medium") {
        filtered = filtered.filter(
          (p) => Number(p.price) >= avgPrice * 0.5 && Number(p.price) <= avgPrice * 1.5
        );
      } else if (priceFilter === "high") {
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.price) > avgPrice * 1.5);
      }
    }

    // Stock filter
    if (stockFilter === "in-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    } else if (stockFilter === "out-of-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    }

    const available = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    const outOfStock = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    
    return { filteredProducts: filtered, availableProducts: available, outOfStockProducts: outOfStock };
  }, [products, searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredProducts.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedAvailableProducts = availableProducts.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  const paginatedOutOfStockProducts = outOfStockProducts.slice(0, itemsPerPage - paginatedAvailableProducts.length);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);


  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          Products
        </h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <ProductSkeleton key={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          Products
        </h2>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <SearchBar
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={setSearchQuery}
          placeholder="Search products by name or description..."
        />
        
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Filter className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" />
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Price:</label>
            <select
              value={priceFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setPriceFilter(e.target.value as any)}
              className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              <option value="all">All Prices</option>
              <option value="low">Low</option>
              <option value="medium">Medium</option>
              <option value="high">High</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Stock:</label>
            <select
              value={stockFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setStockFilter(e.target.value as any)}
              className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              <option value="all">All</option>
              <option value="in-stock">In Stock</option>
              <option value="out-of-stock">Out of Stock</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {availableProducts.length === 0 && outOfStockProducts.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyState type="products" />
      )}

      {availableProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {availableProducts.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard
              key={Number(product.productId)}
              product={product}
              onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
              isAdding={addingToCart === Number(product.productId)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {outOfStockProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-6">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">Out of Stock</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {outOfStockProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard
                key={Number(product.productId)}
                product={product}
                onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
                isAdding={false}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, memo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { getEcommerceContract, getAllProducts, getProductsByCompany, addToCart, Product } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Package, Loader2, ShoppingCart, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Filter } from "lucide-react";
import { ProductSkeleton } from "./LoadingSkeleton";
import { EmptyState } from "./EmptyState";
import { ProductCard } from "./ProductCard";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";

interface ProductListProps {
  companyId?: number; // Optional: filter by company
}

export function ProductList({ companyId }: ProductListProps) {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [addingToCart, setAddingToCart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [priceFilter, setPriceFilter] = useState<"all" | "low" | "medium" | "high">("all");
  const [stockFilter, setStockFilter] = useState<"all" | "in-stock" | "out-of-stock">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(12);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadProducts();
    } else {
      setProducts([]);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer, companyId]);

  const loadProducts = async () => {
    if (!signer) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      let productsData: Product[];

      if (companyId !== undefined) {
        productsData = await getProductsByCompany(contract, companyId);
      } else {
        productsData = await getAllProducts(contract);
      }

      // Filter only active products
      const activeProducts = productsData.filter((p) => p.isActive);
      setProducts(activeProducts);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading products:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load products");
      setProducts([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddToCart = useCallback(async (productId: number, quantity: number = 1) => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !signer) {
      setErrorMessage("Please connect your wallet first");
      return;
    }

    setAddingToCart(productId);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const result = await addToCart(contract, productId, quantity);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessMessage(`Product added to cart successfully!`);
        // Clear success message after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 3000);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to add product to cart");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to add product to cart");
    } finally {
      setAddingToCart(null);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view products.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Memoize filtered and searched products
  const { filteredProducts, availableProducts, outOfStockProducts } = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = products;

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (p) =>
          p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          (p.description && p.description.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      );
    }

    // Price filter
    if (priceFilter !== "all") {
      const avgPrice = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.price), 0) / filtered.length || 0;
      if (priceFilter === "low") {
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.price) < avgPrice * 0.5);
      } else if (priceFilter === "medium") {
        filtered = filtered.filter(
          (p) => Number(p.price) >= avgPrice * 0.5 && Number(p.price) <= avgPrice * 1.5
        );
      } else if (priceFilter === "high") {
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.price) > avgPrice * 1.5);
      }
    }

    // Stock filter
    if (stockFilter === "in-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    } else if (stockFilter === "out-of-stock") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    }

    const available = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) > 0);
    const outOfStock = filtered.filter((p) => Number(p.stock) === 0);
    
    return { filteredProducts: filtered, availableProducts: available, outOfStockProducts: outOfStock };
  }, [products, searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredProducts.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedAvailableProducts = availableProducts.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  const paginatedOutOfStockProducts = outOfStockProducts.slice(0, itemsPerPage - paginatedAvailableProducts.length);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, priceFilter, stockFilter]);


  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          Products
        </h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <ProductSkeleton key={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          Products
        </h2>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <SearchBar
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={setSearchQuery}
          placeholder="Search products by name or description..."
        />
        
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Filter className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" />
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Price:</label>
            <select
              value={priceFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setPriceFilter(e.target.value as any)}
              className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              <option value="all">All Prices</option>
              <option value="low">Low</option>
              <option value="medium">Medium</option>
              <option value="high">High</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Stock:</label>
            <select
              value={stockFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setStockFilter(e.target.value as any)}
              className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              <option value="all">All</option>
              <option value="in-stock">In Stock</option>
              <option value="out-of-stock">Out of Stock</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {successMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-green-800 dark:text-green-300">{successMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3">
          <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">{errorMessage}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {availableProducts.length === 0 && outOfStockProducts.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyState type="products" />
      )}

      {filteredProducts.length === 0 && !loading && (
        <EmptyState type="products" />
      )}

      {paginatedAvailableProducts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {paginatedAvailableProducts.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard
              key={Number(product.productId)}
              product={product}
              onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
              isAdding={addingToCart === Number(product.productId)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {paginatedOutOfStockProducts.length > 0 && currentPage === totalPages && (
        <div className="mt-6">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-4">Out of Stock</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {paginatedOutOfStockProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard
                key={Number(product.productId)}
                product={product}
                onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
                isAdding={false}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {filteredProducts.length > 0 && (
        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          itemsPerPage={itemsPerPage}
          totalItems={filteredProducts.length}
          onItemsPerPageChange={setItemsPerPage}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getInvoicesByCustomer,
  getProduct,
  Invoice,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount, formatAddress } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PayInvoice } from "./PayInvoice";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

export function InvoiceList() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedInvoice, setExpandedInvoice] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadInvoices();
    } else {
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadInvoices = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const invoicesData = await getInvoicesByCustomer(contract, account);

      // Sort invoices by timestamp (newest first)
      const sortedInvoices = invoicesData.sort((a, b) => {
        return Number(b.timestamp) - Number(a.timestamp);
      });

      // Set invoices immediately so they render
      setInvoices(sortedInvoices);

      // Load product details for all invoice items (async, non-blocking)
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const productIds = new Set<number>();

      for (const invoice of invoicesData) {
        for (const item of invoice.items) {
          productIds.add(Number(item.productId));
        }
      }

      // Load products in parallel (non-blocking)
      // Only load if there are product IDs
      if (productIds.size > 0) {
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(productIds).map(async (productId) => {
            try {
              const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
              productsMap.set(productId, product);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
            }
          })
        ).then(() => {
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.error("Error loading products:", err);
          // Still set products map even if some failed
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        });
      } else {
        // No products to load, set empty map immediately
        setProducts(new Map());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading invoices:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoices");
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleInvoice = (invoiceId: number) => {
    setExpandedInvoice(expandedInvoice === invoiceId ? null : invoiceId);
  };

  const formatDate = (timestamp: bigint): string => {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view your invoices.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading invoices...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (invoices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
        Invoices
      </h2>

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {invoices.map((invoice) => {
          const invoiceId = Number(invoice.invoiceId);
          const isExpanded = expandedInvoice === invoiceId;

          return (
            <div
              key={invoiceId}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div
                className="p-6 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-900 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => toggleInvoice(invoiceId)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        Invoice #{invoiceId}
                      </h3>
                      <span
                        className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                          invoice.isPaid
                            ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-400"
                            : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {invoice.isPaid ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Paid
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          "Pending"
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>

                          }}
                          onError={(error) => {
                            console.error("Payment error:", error);
                            setError(`Payment failed: ${error}`);
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getInvoicesByCustomer,
  getProduct,
  Invoice,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount, formatAddress } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PayInvoice } from "./PayInvoice";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

export function InvoiceList() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedInvoice, setExpandedInvoice] = useState<number | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "paid" | "pending">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(10);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadInvoices();
    } else {
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadInvoices = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const invoicesData = await getInvoicesByCustomer(contract, account);

      // Sort invoices by timestamp (newest first)
      const sortedInvoices = invoicesData.sort((a, b) => {
        return Number(b.timestamp) - Number(a.timestamp);
      });

      // Set invoices immediately so they render
      setInvoices(sortedInvoices);

      // Load product details for all invoice items (async, non-blocking)
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const productIds = new Set<number>();

      for (const invoice of invoicesData) {
        for (const item of invoice.items) {
          productIds.add(Number(item.productId));
        }
      }

      // Load products in parallel (non-blocking)
      // Only load if there are product IDs
      if (productIds.size > 0) {
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(productIds).map(async (productId) => {
            try {
              const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
              productsMap.set(productId, product);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
            }
          })
        ).then(() => {
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.error("Error loading products:", err);
          // Still set products map even if some failed
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        });
      } else {
        // No products to load, set empty map immediately
        setProducts(new Map());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading invoices:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoices");
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleInvoice = (invoiceId: number) => {
    setExpandedInvoice(expandedInvoice === invoiceId ? null : invoiceId);
  };

  const formatDate = (timestamp: bigint): string => {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view your invoices.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading invoices...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (invoices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
        <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
        Invoices
      </h2>

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {invoices.map((invoice) => {
          const invoiceId = Number(invoice.invoiceId);
          const isExpanded = expandedInvoice === invoiceId;

          return (
            <div
              key={invoiceId}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div
                className="p-6 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-900 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => toggleInvoice(invoiceId)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        Invoice #{invoiceId}

                            ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-400"
                            : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {invoice.isPaid ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Paid
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          "Pending"
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">

                          Total: <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            €{formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount)}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>{formatDate(invoice.timestamp)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <Package className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>{invoice.items.length} item(s)</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="ml-4">
                    <button
                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-300 transition-colors"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleInvoice(invoiceId);
                      }}
                    >
                      {isExpanded ? "▼" : "▶"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {isExpanded && (
                <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900">
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
                        Invoice Details
                      </h4>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Invoice ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoiceId}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Company ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoice.companyId.toString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Status:</span>
                          <span className={`ml-2 font-medium ${
                            invoice.isPaid
                              ? "text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
```

```typescriptreact
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getInvoicesByCustomer,
  getProduct,
  Invoice,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";

import { PayInvoice } from "./PayInvoice";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

export function InvoiceList() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedInvoice, setExpandedInvoice] = useState<number | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "paid" | "pending">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(10);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadInvoices();
    } else {
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadInvoices = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const invoicesData = await getInvoicesByCustomer(contract, account);

      // Sort invoices by timestamp (newest first)
      const sortedInvoices = invoicesData.sort((a, b) => {
        return Number(b.timestamp) - Number(a.timestamp);
      });

      // Set invoices immediately so they render
      setInvoices(sortedInvoices);

      // Load product details for all invoice items (async, non-blocking)
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const productIds = new Set<number>();

      for (const invoice of invoicesData) {
        for (const item of invoice.items) {
          productIds.add(Number(item.productId));
        }
      }

      // Load products in parallel (non-blocking)
      // Only load if there are product IDs
      if (productIds.size > 0) {
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(productIds).map(async (productId) => {
            try {
              const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
              productsMap.set(productId, product);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
            }
          })
        ).then(() => {
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.error("Error loading products:", err);
          // Still set products map even if some failed
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        });
      } else {
        // No products to load, set empty map immediately
        setProducts(new Map());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading invoices:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoices");
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleInvoice = (invoiceId: number) => {
    setExpandedInvoice(expandedInvoice === invoiceId ? null : invoiceId);
  };

  const formatDate = (timestamp: bigint): string => {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  // Filter and search invoices
  const filteredInvoices = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = invoices;

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (inv) =>
          inv.invoiceId.toString().includes(query) ||
          inv.companyId.toString().includes(query)
      );
    }

    // Status filter
    if (statusFilter === "paid") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => inv.isPaid);
    } else if (statusFilter === "pending") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => !inv.isPaid);
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [invoices, searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredInvoices.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedInvoices = filteredInvoices.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">

    );

  if (loading) {

              {isExpanded && (

                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
                        Invoice Details
                      </h4>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Invoice ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoiceId}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Company ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoice.companyId.toString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Status:</span>
                          <span className={`ml-2 font-medium ${
                            invoice.isPaid
                              ? "text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
                              : "text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400"
                          }`}>
                            {invoice.isPaid ? "Paid" : "Pending"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {invoice.isPaid && invoice.paymentTxHash && (
                          <div>
                            <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Payment Tx:</span>
                            <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                              {formatAddress(invoice.paymentTxHash, 8)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
                        Items
                      </h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {invoice.items.map((item, index) => {
                          const productId = Number(item.productId);
                          const product = products.get(productId);

                          return (
                            <div
                              key={index}
                              className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
                            >
                              {product ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                  <div className="flex-1">
                                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                      {product.name}
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      {product.description}
                                    </p>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="text-right ml-4">
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      Quantity: <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                        {item.quantity.toString()}
                                      </span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      Price: <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                        €{formatTokenAmount(product.price)}
                                      </span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                                      Subtotal: €{formatTokenAmount(product.price * BigInt(item.quantity))}
                                    </p>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                                  Loading product {productId}...
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          Total Amount:
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                          €{formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {!invoice.isPaid && (
                      <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                        <PayInvoice
                          invoiceId={invoiceId}
                          amount={Number(formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount))}
                          onSuccess={(paymentIntentId) => {
                            console.log("Payment successful:", paymentIntentId);
                            // Reload invoices to reflect payment status
                            loadInvoices();
                          }}
                          onError={(error) => {
                            console.error("Payment error:", error);
                            setError(`Payment failed: ${error}`);
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getInvoicesByCustomer,
  getProduct,
  Invoice,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount, formatAddress } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PayInvoice } from "./PayInvoice";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

export function InvoiceList() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedInvoice, setExpandedInvoice] = useState<number | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "paid" | "pending">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(10);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadInvoices();
    } else {
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadInvoices = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const invoicesData = await getInvoicesByCustomer(contract, account);

      // Sort invoices by timestamp (newest first)
      const sortedInvoices = invoicesData.sort((a, b) => {
        return Number(b.timestamp) - Number(a.timestamp);
      });

      // Set invoices immediately so they render
      setInvoices(sortedInvoices);

      // Load product details for all invoice items (async, non-blocking)
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const productIds = new Set<number>();

      for (const invoice of invoicesData) {
        for (const item of invoice.items) {
          productIds.add(Number(item.productId));
        }
      }

      // Load products in parallel (non-blocking)
      // Only load if there are product IDs
      if (productIds.size > 0) {
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(productIds).map(async (productId) => {
            try {
              const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
              productsMap.set(productId, product);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
            }
          })
        ).then(() => {
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.error("Error loading products:", err);
          // Still set products map even if some failed
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        });
      } else {
        // No products to load, set empty map immediately
        setProducts(new Map());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading invoices:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoices");
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleInvoice = (invoiceId: number) => {
    setExpandedInvoice(expandedInvoice === invoiceId ? null : invoiceId);
  };

  const formatDate = (timestamp: bigint): string => {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  // Filter and search invoices
  const filteredInvoices = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = invoices;

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (inv) =>
          inv.invoiceId.toString().includes(query) ||
          inv.companyId.toString().includes(query)
      );
    }

    // Status filter
    if (statusFilter === "paid") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => inv.isPaid);
    } else if (statusFilter === "pending") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => !inv.isPaid);
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [invoices, searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredInvoices.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedInvoices = filteredInvoices.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view your invoices.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading invoices...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (invoices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <SearchBar
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={setSearchQuery}
          placeholder="Search invoices by ID or company..."
        />
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Filter className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" />
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Status:</label>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as any)}
            className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          >
            <option value="all">All Status</option>
            <option value="paid">Paid</option>
            <option value="pending">Pending</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {filteredInvoices.length === 0 && !loading && (
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          {searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" ? (
            <p className="text-sm mt-2">Try adjusting your search or filters</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {paginatedInvoices.map((invoice) => {
          const invoiceId = Number(invoice.invoiceId);
          const isExpanded = expandedInvoice === invoiceId;

          return (
            <div
              key={invoiceId}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div
                className="p-6 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-900 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => toggleInvoice(invoiceId)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        Invoice #{invoiceId}
                      </h3>
                      <span
                        className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                          invoice.isPaid
                            ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-400"
                            : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {invoice.isPaid ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Paid
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          "Pending"
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">

                        <span>
                          Total: <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            €{formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount)}
                          </span>

                        <span>{formatDate(invoice.timestamp)}</span>

                        <Package className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>{invoice.items.length} item(s)</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="ml-4">
                    <button
                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-300 transition-colors"

                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleInvoice(invoiceId);
                      }}
                    >
                      {isExpanded ? "▼" : "▶"}
                    </button>

              {isExpanded && (

                  <div className="space-y-4">

                          amount={Number(formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount))}
                          onSuccess={(paymentIntentId) => {
                            console.log("Payment successful:", paymentIntentId);
                            // Reload invoices to reflect payment status
                            loadInvoices();
                          }}
                          onError={(error) => {
                            console.error("Payment error:", error);
                            setError(`Payment failed: ${error}`);
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
