```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import {
  getEcommerceContract,
  getInvoicesByCustomer,
  getProduct,
  Invoice,
  Product,
} from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { formatTokenAmount, formatAddress } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PayInvoice } from "./PayInvoice";
import { SearchBar } from "./SearchBar";
import { Pagination } from "./Pagination";
import {
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  XCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Package,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

export function InvoiceList() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer } = useWallet();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Map<number, Product>>(new Map());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedInvoice, setExpandedInvoice] = useState<number | null>(null);
  
  // Search and filter state
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "paid" | "pending">("all");
  
  // Pagination state
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(10);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isConnected && account && signer) {
      loadInvoices();
    } else {
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, signer]);

  const loadInvoices = async () => {
    if (!signer || !account) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(signer);
      const invoicesData = await getInvoicesByCustomer(contract, account);

      // Sort invoices by timestamp (newest first)
      const sortedInvoices = invoicesData.sort((a, b) => {
        return Number(b.timestamp) - Number(a.timestamp);
      });

      // Set invoices immediately so they render
      setInvoices(sortedInvoices);

      // Load product details for all invoice items (async, non-blocking)
      const productsMap = new Map<number, Product>();
      const productIds = new Set<number>();

      for (const invoice of invoicesData) {
        for (const item of invoice.items) {
          productIds.add(Number(item.productId));
        }
      }

      // Load products in parallel (non-blocking)
      // Only load if there are product IDs
      if (productIds.size > 0) {
        Promise.all(
          Array.from(productIds).map(async (productId) => {
            try {
              const product = await getProduct(contract, productId);
              productsMap.set(productId, product);
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error loading product ${productId}:`, err);
            }
          })
        ).then(() => {
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        }).catch((err) => {
          console.error("Error loading products:", err);
          // Still set products map even if some failed
          setProducts(new Map(productsMap));
        });
      } else {
        // No products to load, set empty map immediately
        setProducts(new Map());
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading invoices:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load invoices");
      setInvoices([]);
      setProducts(new Map());
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleInvoice = (invoiceId: number) => {
    setExpandedInvoice(expandedInvoice === invoiceId ? null : invoiceId);
  };

  const formatDate = (timestamp: bigint): string => {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp) * 1000);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  // Filter and search invoices
  const filteredInvoices = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = invoices;

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(
        (inv) =>
          inv.invoiceId.toString().includes(query) ||
          inv.companyId.toString().includes(query)
      );
    }

    // Status filter
    if (statusFilter === "paid") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => inv.isPaid);
    } else if (statusFilter === "pending") {
      filtered = filtered.filter((inv) => !inv.isPaid);
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [invoices, searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  // Pagination
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredInvoices.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const paginatedInvoices = filteredInvoices.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, statusFilter]);

  if (!isConnected) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 border border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800 rounded-lg text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Wallet Not Connected</p>
          <p className="text-sm">Please connect your wallet to view your invoices.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg">
        <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        <span className="ml-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Loading invoices...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-start gap-3">
        <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div>
          <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Error</p>
          <p className="text-sm">{error}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (invoices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
          Invoices
        </h2>
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <SearchBar
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={setSearchQuery}
          placeholder="Search invoices by ID or company..."
        />
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Filter className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400" />
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Status:</label>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as any)}
            className="px-3 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          >
            <option value="all">All Status</option>
            <option value="paid">Paid</option>
            <option value="pending">Pending</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {filteredInvoices.length === 0 && !loading && (
        <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
          <FileText className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p className="text-lg font-medium">No invoices found</p>
          {searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" ? (
            <p className="text-sm mt-2">Try adjusting your search or filters</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm mt-2">Your invoices will appear here once you make a purchase</p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {paginatedInvoices.map((invoice) => {
          const invoiceId = Number(invoice.invoiceId);
          const isExpanded = expandedInvoice === invoiceId;

          return (
            <div
              key={invoiceId}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div
                className="p-6 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-900 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => toggleInvoice(invoiceId)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                        Invoice #{invoiceId}
                      </h3>
                      <span
                        className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                          invoice.isPaid
                            ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-400"
                            : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {invoice.isPaid ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Paid
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          "Pending"
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>
                          Total: <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            €{formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount)}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>{formatDate(invoice.timestamp)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                        <Package className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>{invoice.items.length} item(s)</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="ml-4">
                    <button
                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-300 transition-colors"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleInvoice(invoiceId);
                      }}
                    >
                      {isExpanded ? "▼" : "▶"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {isExpanded && (
                <div className="border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900">
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
                        Invoice Details
                      </h4>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Invoice ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoiceId}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Company ID:</span>
                          <span className="ml-2 text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                            {invoice.companyId.toString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Status:</span>
                          <span className={`ml-2 font-medium ${
                            invoice.isPaid
                              ? "text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
                              : "text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400"
                          }`}>
                            {invoice.isPaid ? "Paid" : "Pending"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {invoice.isPaid && invoice.paymentTxHash && (
                          <div>
                            <span className="text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">Payment Tx:</span>
                            <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                              {formatAddress(invoice.paymentTxHash, 8)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-3">
                        Items
                      </h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {invoice.items.map((item, index) => {
                          const productId = Number(item.productId);
                          const product = products.get(productId);

                          return (
                            <div
                              key={index}
                              className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700"
                            >
                              {product ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                  <div className="flex-1">
                                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                      {product.name}
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      {product.description}
                                    </p>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="text-right ml-4">
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      Quantity: <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                        {item.quantity.toString()}
                                      </span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
                                      Price: <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                                        €{formatTokenAmount(product.price)}
                                      </span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                                      Subtotal: €{formatTokenAmount(product.price * BigInt(item.quantity))}
                                    </p>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                                  Loading product {productId}...
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          Total Amount:
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                          €{formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {!invoice.isPaid && (
                      <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
                        <PayInvoice
                          invoiceId={invoiceId}
                          amount={Number(formatTokenAmount(invoice.totalAmount))}
                          onSuccess={(paymentIntentId) => {
                            console.log("Payment successful:", paymentIntentId);
                            // Reload invoices to reflect payment status
                            loadInvoices();
                          }}
                          onError={(error) => {
                            console.error("Payment error:", error);
                            setError(`Payment failed: ${error}`);
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {filteredInvoices.length > 0 && (
        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          itemsPerPage={itemsPerPage}
          totalItems={filteredInvoices.length}
          onItemsPerPageChange={setItemsPerPage}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useDebounce } from "@/hooks/useDebounce";

interface SearchBarProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export function SearchBar({ value, onChange, placeholder = "Search...", debounceMs = 300 }: SearchBarProps) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const debouncedValue = useDebounce(localValue, debounceMs);

  // Update parent when debounced value changes
  useEffect(() => {
    onChange(debouncedValue);
  }, [debouncedValue, onChange]);

  // Sync with external value changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalValue(value);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" />
      <input
        type="text"
        value={localValue}
        onChange={(e) => setLocalValue(e.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
      />
      {localValue && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setLocalValue("")}
          className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-300"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

import { CustomerForm } from "@/components/CustomerForm";
import { ProductList } from "@/components/ProductList";

                  >

            </nav>

            {/* Customer Registration Section */}
            <div className="pt-6 border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 px-4">
                <User className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                  Account
                </h3>
              </div>
              <div className="px-4">
                <CustomerForm />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </aside>

Corrigiendo NotificationContext y agregando un hook para notificaciones en tiempo real basadas en eventos de blockchain:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { Bell, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle, Info } from "lucide-react";

export type NotificationType = "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";

export interface Notification {
  id: string;
  type: NotificationType;
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  read: boolean;
  autoClose?: boolean;
  duration?: number;
}

interface NotificationContextType {
  notifications: Notification[];
  addNotification: (notification: Omit<Notification, "id" | "timestamp" | "read">) => void;
  removeNotification: (id: string) => void;
  markAsRead: (id: string) => void;
  markAllAsRead: () => void;
  clearAll: () => void;
  unreadCount: number;
}

const NotificationContext = createContext<NotificationContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function NotificationProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);

  const addNotification = useCallback(
    (notification: Omit<Notification, "id" | "timestamp" | "read">) => {
      const id = `notification-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
      const newNotification: Notification = {
        ...notification,
        id,
        timestamp: new Date(),
        read: false,
        autoClose: notification.autoClose ?? true,
        duration: notification.duration ?? 5000,
      };

      setNotifications((prev) => [newNotification, ...prev]);

      // Auto-close if enabled
      if (newNotification.autoClose) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          setNotifications((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
        }, newNotification.duration);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const removeNotification = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const markAsRead = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications((prev) =>
      prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n))
    );
  }, []);

  const markAllAsRead = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, read: true })));
  }, []);

  const clearAll = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications([]);
  }, []);

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length;

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider
      value={{
        notifications,
        addNotification,
        removeNotification,
        markAsRead,
        markAllAsRead,
        clearAll,
        unreadCount,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useNotifications() {
  const context = useContext(NotificationContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useNotifications must be used within NotificationProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

// Notification Bell Component
export function NotificationBell() {
  const { notifications, unreadCount, markAllAsRead, markAsRead } = useNotifications();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const getIcon = (type: NotificationType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "success":
        return <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />;
      case "error":
        return <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
      case "warning":
        return <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />;
      case "info":
        return <Info className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="relative p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors"
      >
        <Bell className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300" />
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            {unreadCount > 9 ? "9+" : unreadCount}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <>
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg shadow-lg z-50 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Notifications</h3>
              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                <button
                  onClick={markAllAsRead}
                  className="text-sm text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline"
                >
                  Mark all as read
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {notifications.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                <Bell className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50" />
                <p>No notifications</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700">
                {notifications.map((notification) => (
                  <div
                    key={notification.id}
                    className={`p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      !notification.read ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20" : ""
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!notification.read) {
                        markAsRead(notification.id);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      {getIcon(notification.type)}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {notification.title}
                        </p>
                        {notification.message && (
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">
                            {notification.message}
                          </p>
                        )}
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-500 mt-1">
                          {notification.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString()}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      {!notification.read && (
                        <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-500 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 mt-2" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { useNotifications } from "@/contexts/NotificationContext";
import { getEcommerceContract } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { ethers } from "ethers";

/**
 * Hook para escuchar eventos de blockchain y generar notificaciones en tiempo real
 */
export function useBlockchainNotifications() {
  const { account, isConnected, signer, provider } = useWallet();
  const { addNotification } = useNotifications();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !provider) return;

    const ecommerceAddress = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    if (!ecommerceAddress) return;

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(provider);
      
      // Listen for InvoiceCreated events
      const invoiceCreatedFilter = contract.filters.InvoiceCreated(null, null, account);
      contract.on(invoiceCreatedFilter, (invoiceId, companyId, customerAddress, totalAmount, event) => {
        addNotification({
          type: "info",
          title: "New Invoice Created",
          message: `Invoice #${invoiceId.toString()} for €${(Number(totalAmount) / 1e6).toFixed(2)}`,
          autoClose: true,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      });

      // Listen for InvoicePaid events
      const invoicePaidFilter = contract.filters.InvoicePaid(null, null);
      contract.on(invoicePaidFilter, (invoiceId, paymentTxHash, event) => {
        addNotification({
          type: "success",
          title: "Invoice Paid",
          message: `Invoice #${invoiceId.toString()} has been paid successfully`,
          autoClose: true,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      });

      // Listen for CartItemAdded events
      const cartItemAddedFilter = contract.filters.CartItemAdded(account);
      contract.on(cartItemAddedFilter, (customer, productId, quantity, event) => {
        addNotification({
          type: "info",
          title: "Item Added to Cart",
          message: `Product #${productId.toString()} (x${quantity.toString()}) added to cart`,
          autoClose: true,
          duration: 3000,
        });
      });

      // Cleanup listeners on unmount
      return () => {
        contract.removeAllListeners(invoiceCreatedFilter);
        contract.removeAllListeners(invoicePaidFilter);
        contract.removeAllListeners(cartItemAddedFilter);
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error setting up blockchain notifications:", error);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, provider, addNotification]);
}

Corrigiendo el hook de notificaciones para usar correctamente los eventos del contrato:


```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useWallet } from "@/contexts/WalletContext";
import { useNotifications } from "@/contexts/NotificationContext";
import { getEcommerceContract } from "@/lib/ecommerce";
import { ethers } from "ethers";

/**
 * Hook para escuchar eventos de blockchain y generar notificaciones en tiempo real
 */
export function useBlockchainNotifications() {
  const { account, isConnected, provider } = useWallet();
  const { addNotification } = useNotifications();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isConnected || !account || !provider) return;

    const ecommerceAddress = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ECOMMERCE_ADDRESS;
    if (!ecommerceAddress) return;

    try {
      const contract = getEcommerceContract(provider);
      
      // Listen for InvoiceCreated events (filtered by customer address)
      const invoiceCreatedHandler = (invoiceId: bigint, companyId: bigint, customerAddress: string, totalAmount: bigint) => {
        if (customerAddress.toLowerCase() === account.toLowerCase()) {
          addNotification({
            type: "info",
            title: "New Invoice Created",
            message: `Invoice #${invoiceId.toString()} for €${(Number(totalAmount) / 1e6).toFixed(2)}`,
            autoClose: true,
            duration: 5000,
          });
        }
      };

      // Listen for InvoicePaid events
      const invoicePaidHandler = (invoiceId: bigint, paymentTxHash: string) => {
        addNotification({
          type: "success",
          title: "Invoice Paid",
          message: `Invoice #${invoiceId.toString()} has been paid successfully`,
          autoClose: true,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      };

      // Listen for CartItemAdded events (filtered by customer address)
      const cartItemAddedHandler = (customer: string, productId: bigint, quantity: bigint) => {
        if (customer.toLowerCase() === account.toLowerCase()) {
          addNotification({
            type: "info",
            title: "Item Added to Cart",
            message: `Product #${productId.toString()} (x${quantity.toString()}) added to cart`,
            autoClose: true,
            duration: 3000,
          });
        }
      };

      // Set up event listeners
      contract.on("InvoiceCreated", invoiceCreatedHandler);
      contract.on("InvoicePaid", invoicePaidHandler);
      contract.on("CartItemAdded", cartItemAddedHandler);

      // Cleanup listeners on unmount
      return () => {
        contract.off("InvoiceCreated", invoiceCreatedHandler);
        contract.off("InvoicePaid", invoicePaidHandler);
        contract.off("CartItemAdded", cartItemAddedHandler);
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error setting up blockchain notifications:", error);
    }
  }, [isConnected, account, provider, addNotification]);
}


```

# 🎉 Nuevas Funcionalidades Implementadas

**Fecha**: $(date)  
**Estado**: ✅ Completado

---

## 📋 Resumen

Se han implementado tres funcionalidades principales solicitadas:

1. ✅ **Búsqueda y Filtros** en listas
2. ✅ **Paginación** para listas largas
3. ✅ **Notificaciones en Tiempo Real** basadas en eventos de blockchain

---

## 1. 🔍 Búsqueda y Filtros

### Componentes Creados

#### `SearchBar.tsx`
- Componente reutilizable para búsqueda con debounce
- Integración con `useDebounce` hook
- Limpieza automática del input
- Soporte para dark mode

**Características:**
- Debounce de 300ms por defecto (configurable)
- Icono de búsqueda y botón de limpieza
- Sincronización con estado externo

### Implementación en Componentes

#### `ProductList.tsx` (Tienda Online)
- ✅ Búsqueda por nombre y descripción
- ✅ Filtro por precio (Low, Medium, High)
- ✅ Filtro por stock (In Stock, Out of Stock)
- ✅ Filtros combinables

#### `InvoiceList.tsx` (Tienda Online)
- ✅ Búsqueda por ID de factura o empresa
- ✅ Filtro por estado (Paid, Pending)
- ✅ Filtros combinables

### Uso

```tsx
<SearchBar
  value={searchQuery}
  onChange={setSearchQuery}
  placeholder="Search products..."
/>
```

---

## 2. 📄 Paginación

### Componente Creado

#### `Pagination.tsx`
- Componente reutilizable para paginación
- Navegación con botones anterior/siguiente
- Números de página con elipsis para listas largas
- Selector de items por página (10, 20, 50, 100)
- Contador de resultados

**Características:**
- Muestra máximo 5 páginas visibles
- Elipsis para listas muy largas
- Responsive design
- Soporte para dark mode

### Implementación en Componentes

#### `ProductList.tsx`
- ✅ Paginación de productos disponibles
- ✅ 12 items por página por defecto
- ✅ Configurable (10, 20, 50, 100)

#### `InvoiceList.tsx`
- ✅ Paginación de facturas
- ✅ 10 items por página por defecto
- ✅ Configurable (10, 20, 50, 100)

### Uso

```tsx
<Pagination
  currentPage={currentPage}
  totalPages={totalPages}
  onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
  itemsPerPage={itemsPerPage}
  totalItems={filteredItems.length}
  onItemsPerPageChange={setItemsPerPage}
/>
```

---

## 3. 🔔 Notificaciones en Tiempo Real

### Componentes Creados

#### `NotificationContext.tsx`
- Context Provider para gestión de notificaciones
- Sistema de notificaciones con tipos (success, error, warning, info)
- Auto-cierre configurable
- Contador de notificaciones no leídas
- Componente `NotificationBell` para mostrar notificaciones

**Características:**
- Notificaciones persistentes o temporales
- Marcar como leídas
- Limpiar todas las notificaciones
- Contador de no leídas
- Dropdown con lista de notificaciones

#### `useBlockchainNotifications.ts`
- Hook para escuchar eventos de blockchain
- Notificaciones automáticas basadas en eventos del contrato
- Filtrado por dirección del usuario

**Eventos Escuchados:**
- `InvoiceCreated`: Nueva factura creada
- `InvoicePaid`: Factura pagada
- `CartItemAdded`: Item agregado al carrito

### Integración

#### `app/layout.tsx`
- ✅ `NotificationProvider` agregado al layout
- ✅ Disponible en toda la aplicación

#### `app/page.tsx` (Tienda Online)
- ✅ `NotificationBell` agregado al header
- ✅ `useBlockchainNotifications` activado

### Uso

```tsx
// En cualquier componente
import { useNotifications } from "@/contexts/NotificationContext";

const { addNotification } = useNotifications();

addNotification({
  type: "success",
  title: "Payment Successful",
  message: "Your payment has been processed",
  autoClose: true,
  duration: 5000,
});
```

## Funcionalidades implementadas

### 1. Búsqueda y filtros

Componentes creados:
- `SearchBar.tsx`: componente reutilizable con debounce
- Integrado en `ProductList` y `InvoiceList`

Características:
- Búsqueda por nombre/descripción en productos
- Búsqueda por ID/empresa en facturas
- Filtros por precio (Low, Medium, High)
- Filtros por stock (In Stock, Out of Stock)
- Filtros por estado (Paid, Pending) en facturas
- Filtros combinables

### 2. Paginación

Componente creado:
- `Pagination.tsx`: componente reutilizable

Características:
- Navegación anterior/siguiente
- Números de página con elipsis
- Selector de items por página (10, 20, 50, 100)
- Contador de resultados
- Responsive

Implementado en:
- `ProductList`: 12 items por página (configurable)
- `InvoiceList`: 10 items por página (configurable)

### 3. Notificaciones en tiempo real

Componentes creados:
- `NotificationContext.tsx`: sistema de notificaciones
- `NotificationBell.tsx`: componente visual
- `useBlockchainNotifications.ts`: hook para eventos de blockchain

Características:
- Notificaciones automáticas basadas en eventos:
  - `InvoiceCreated`: nueva factura creada
  - `InvoicePaid`: factura pagada
  - `CartItemAdded`: item agregado al carrito
- Tipos: success, error, warning, info
- Auto-cierre configurable
- Contador de no leídas
- Dropdown con historial

Integración:
- `NotificationProvider` en el layout
- `NotificationBell` en el header de la tienda online
- Hook activado automáticamente
